overview: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

title: Operation Kabul
overview: A Hungarian doctor's story intertwines with soldiers' sacrificial fight and desperate refugees' escape from a war-torn city.

overview: The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.

title: Jeffrey Dollmer
overview: Dahmer finds a doll in 1991 and performs a ritual in an attempt to transfer his spirit into it but is captured before he can finish his evil plans. For decades, the doll remains locked away in police evidence — until it is finally discarded and finds its way back into the world. In the present day, the doll’s spirit is accidentally summoned and quickly latches onto a young model who bears a resemblance to its former owner. When the model travels to a remote photo shoot, the possessed doll follows, turning the isolated set into a killing ground as it begins stalking fellow competitors and co-workers.

title: Ekis
overview: Erik Matti’s classic Ekis gets a bold reboot with an all-girls ensemble led by Angela Morena, Cheena Dizon, and Aliya Raymundo. A crew of female thugs launches a kidnap-for-ransom plot, but when things go wrong, escaping the chaos becomes impossible.

title: DreamQuil
overview: In a near future where poor air quality forces people into virtual lives, a dissatisfied mother joins a digital wellness retreat, only to return home and discover that a robotic replacement has taken her place, leading to a sinister mystery.

title: Nuremberg
overview: In postwar Germany, an American psychiatrist must determine whether Nazi prisoners are fit to go on trial for war crimes, and finds himself in a complex battle of intellect and ethics with Hermann Göring, Hitler's right-hand man.

title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
overview: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

title: Il rumore delle cose nuove
overview: A vividly interwoven tale of secrets and connections, Il rumore delle cose nuove centers on three families whose lives have quietly overlapped in the streets of Milan—unaware of each other—for years. Andrea, a photographer, and Andreina, a nurse, share a haunting truth: Andreina has given a part of herself to keep Andrea alive. Umberto finds solace in alleviating others’ pain at work, yet at home he inflicts suffering upon Alba, once hopeful, now dreamless. In another household, Ralph, who crafts sounds, and Viola, an actress who yearns to live as freely as she performs, are quietly struggling—alongside Mirko, a ten‑year‑old whose presence echoes loudly. As the story unfolds, their ordinary routines unravel under the weight of these “noisy” secrets—some seemingly trivial, others utterly unbearable. Chaos tumbles over the fragile bonds holding them together, forcing confrontations with truths they can no longer ignore.

title: Dead Man's Wire
overview: In 1977, former real estate developer Tony Kiritsis puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.

title: Killing Time
overview: In an era of economic despair and record-high unemployment, where becoming a YouTuber is the ultimate dream job, the popular YouTube crew 'Killing Time' collapses overnight after an unforeseen accident claims a team member's life during a live broadcast. Desperate for a successful comeback, the members plot to return with far more extreme and sensational content. However, just as success seems within reach, mysterious figures appear and propose the 'real' Killing Time.

title: Pray for Us
overview: In the mid-to-late 1970s, two young women from different social backgrounds meet inside the Patronato de Protección a la Mujer (Women’s Protection Board), a state-backed institution that confined thousands of women, many single mothers, in convents and boarding schools under the guise of moral 'reform'. Ana, a rebellious 19-year-old from Barcelona, is sent by her wealthy father to a Patronato facility overseen by the merciless Sister Socorro. Amid the harsh conditions, Ana forms a deep bond with Sole, a friendship tested by escape attempts, reprisals, and an ultimate sacrifice.

title: TRON: Ares
overview: A highly sophisticated Program called Ares is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission, marking humankind's first encounter with A.I. beings.

title: Shark Lake
overview: A couple travel to a remote hotel hoping to repair their relationship, only to discover that the mysterious owner is hiding a deadly secret involving his hungry pet shark, Cinnamon.

title: We Are Wild
overview: When a young abused housewife runs away from home she finds herself in a 1970’s utopia in the woods with a ragtag group of misfit hippies. Is she free or did she give up one prison for another?

title: God Laughs
overview: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

overview: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

overview: Quitting her job and being pregnant - that's the sum of what we know about Eunju. Seemingly without much desire or expectation, Eunju heads to the countryside at the suggestion of Changho, who proposes a month of seasonal farm work. She tidies up rice straw left over from threshing, tends to cattle, sits down to eat with rough-hewn men of the countryside, and exchanges brief, trivial, awkward conversations.

title: Um Tio Quase Perfeito 3
overview: Uncle Tony feels increasingly abandoned by his nephews, who have grown up and become independent. Then, one day, a baby is left on his doorstep. Uncertain of what to do, he calls on them, and together they hatch wild schemes to find the child's parents.

title: Ferine
overview: A tragic event shatters a rich art collector's life, awakening her primal nature. She destroys her privileged existence to build a new concept of family, leading her on a path of destruction and animalistic transformation.

title: Godzilla Minus One
overview: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

title: Rom Coms Must Die
overview: A disgruntled filmmaker and his sidekick cousin takes drastic actions to get their second film produced in a changing world of motion picture storytelling.

title: New Group
overview: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. One day, the people in her school inexplicably start to form a human pyramid. The principal and other teachers start to act weird and encourage taking part in it, and the various gymnastic formations start to spread and take over the whole town. Eventually only Ai and Yuu, a transfer student who finds it hard to fit in, are left to rebel against the conformity madness.

title: Awarapan 2
overview: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead
overview: When his brother disappears and everyone forgets he existed, Sam must unravel the mystery before Finn is gone forever.

With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.

overview: Sao, a talented cook, accidentally meets the man who took advantage of her in the past. She sets her revenge plan in motion using her cooking skill to achieve a rather unexpected result.

title: Fear Street: Prom Queen
overview: Who will be voted queen at Shadyside High's 1988 prom? For underdog Lori, competition is cutthroat even before someone starts killing off the candidates.

title: Rough Draft

title: Motor City

Between daily life, the land, and powwows, the film accompanies a living transmission: that of a language, gestures, and a way of inhabiting the world, carried by a lineage of women where kokom remains ever-present. Without attempting to explain, SWEETGRASS observes what circulates between them, transforms, and takes root over time.

To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind. As the tournament draws near, Audrey questions her next move that will take her away from the people and places she loves…and decide if she’s ready to walk away from Wonderlanes – or finally put down roots where her heart truly belongs.

title: Inherit

His desperation drives him into the arms of the Kurdish gangster boss Mazlum, also known as the Dutchman, and back to his friend from drug therapy, Cem. Together, they weave the threads of an organization that casts its nets even beyond the prison walls, but at the height of euphoria, Alex suddenly finds himself caught in it. He is left with only two options: Succumb to the conspiracy of intrigue and betrayal or become a monster himself.

title: Elio

Instead, she lands a feel-good story profiling Darlene Donnelly, a beloved Chicago Bears superfan about to celebrate an incredible milestone: attending her 500th game. There's just one catch: Avery knows next to nothing about football or Chicago. Enter Darlene's handsome grandson Matt, a Chicago firefighter and die-hard Bears fan who, with a little gentle nudging from Darlene, agrees to show Avery what being a part of Bears Nation is all about.

title: The Devil's Mouth
overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
original_title: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

title: The Anacondas
overview: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

title: Comrade Kalyan

As her family scrambles to find her, Claire discovers the unexpected magic of a Christmas gone off-script.

title: The Last Kiss
overview: A young woman discovers she can foresee the death of anyone she kisses, and when a vision predicts her crush will die in a murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to uncover the killer before more lives are lost.

title: On Behalf of My Son
overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi

Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

title: Cliffhanger

Ray’s other daughter Naomi, still haunted by a past climbing accident, witnesses the attack and escapes. To save her family, she must confront her fears and fight for survival.

The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

They fold the towels they share, wash their bowls, and make up games together. They fight and make up all the time, growing up the way children should, through play. On their 100th day of school, the older kids hold a 100th-day anniversary party for them. A year later, now second graders themselves, they prepare the party for a new class of first graders. In banana freeze tag, a frozen player becomes a banana with arms raised overhead, and only a friend peeling them down can set the player free. In a society driven by anxiety, in search of lost time, for children and adults alike. Banana Freeze Tag!

overview: Dé, Adrianim and Martins are three black teenagers from Chatuba, Rio de Janeiro. When Dé receives the news that Almerinda, his grandmother, is in the terminal phase of Alzheimer's disease, he decides to enjoy the last days of her life together with his two best friends.

title: Roofman
overview: A former Army Ranger and struggling father turns to robbing McDonald’s restaurants by cutting holes in their roofs, earning him the nickname "Roofman." After escaping prison, he secretly lives inside a Toys “R” Us for six months, surviving undetected while planning his next move. But when he falls for a divorced mom drawn to his undeniable charm, his double life begins to unravel, setting off a compelling and suspenseful game of cat and mouse as his past closes in.

title: The Lost Bus
overview: A determined father risks everything to rescue a dedicated teacher and her students from a raging wildfire.

title: Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog
original_title: Hopper et le secret de la marmotte
overview: Chickenhare embarks on an epic quest, a mysterious groundhog with the power to reverse time and save his species. His adventure takes a dangerous turn when his group discover they are not the only ones searching for this ancient power.

title: Fight or Flight
overview: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking down a target on a plane but must protect that target when they're surrounded by people trying to kill both of them.

title: Miroirs No. 3
overview: After a car crash kills her boyfriend, piano student Laura is taken in by Betty, who witnessed the accident. Living with Betty's family brings comfort, but Laura starts questioning their intentions as time passes.

title: The Light
overview: A portrait of a modern family between collapse and new beginnings dealing with the big issues of our times, in a world that is reeling. Tim, Milena, their almost grown-up twins Frieda and Jon and their illegitimate son Dio - this is the Engels family, who seemingly have nothing left to hold them together when housekeeper Farrah enters their lives. The mysterious Syrian woman puts the Engels' emotional world to an unexpectedly wild test.

title: The Holy Boy
overview: A PE teacher moves to a isolated mountain village where the people appear to live in unshakeable serenity, but soon stumbles across a disturbing ritual. title: Companion

title: Without Blood
overview: Nina, driven by revenge after losing her family during a devastating war, tracks down the man she believes holds the answers to their deaths.

title: The Accountant²
overview: When an old acquaintance is murdered, Wolff is compelled to solve the case. Realizing more extreme measures are necessary, Wolff recruits his estranged and highly lethal brother, Brax, to help. In partnership with Marybeth Medina, they uncover a deadly conspiracy, becoming targets of a ruthless network of killers who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets buried.

title: A Complete Unknown
overview: New York, early 1960s. Against the backdrop of a vibrant music scene and tumultuous cultural upheaval, an enigmatic 19-year-old from Minnesota arrives in the West Village with his guitar and revolutionary talent, destined to change the course of American music.

title: Zi
overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

title: Angel in White
overview: In early 2020, when the COVID-19 outbreak struck Wuhan, doctors Yuan Chuchu and Shen Yun joined forces with medical workers nationwide who answered the national call, rushing to the city to collaborate with local healthcare teams in tirelessly treating patients, ultimately containing the pandemic through the country's precise prevention measures and united efforts, composing a heroic anthem of this anti-virus battle.

title: A Ray of Sunlight
overview: Okhee is a lower-class diver in the city. One day, Eunyoung, the daughter of her late husband, comes to visit. What’s more, Kyeongsik, Okhee’s son, who is being chased by creditors, leaves his young son Junseo with them and disappears. Eunyoung wasn’t planning to stay long but misses the chance to leave due to Okhee's accident and the appearance of her step-nephew, Junseo. Eunyoung starts to live together with Okhee, but everything feels uncomfortable.

title: The Invisible Guest
overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

title: Holiday Unplugged
overview: Sally, an art teacher, has spent the last 10 years honoring the memory of her late husband, Jake, while raising their children, Keegan and Boo. Feeling like she’s finally ready for love, she joins a dating app and is matched with Damon, her former colleague who taught her kids’ kindergarten class. Jake had co-founded a web platform that preserved family home videos. When a server migration wipes out Sally’s treasured videos of him – and her phone containing backup copies accidentally shatters – the only hope is finding the original tapes. She doesn’t want Keegan and Boo to know about the missing videos so to buy time until they’re recovered, Sally institutes a screen-free Christmas for her family while secretly searching for the tapes.

title: One Last Order
overview: A cherished drive-thru worker receives the day's proceeds as her going-away gift when the community queues up to bid her farewell on her last day in Gainesville.

title: Blind Game
overview: A Cop, under suspension, is on the trail of Missing Cash.

title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
overview: Unable to reach Lianhua Town, Xiaoqing stumbles upon the frame of a car buried under silt four years ago. Then a wild idea strikes him: restore the car and drive there. Meanwhile, Dapang, eager for a tasty treat, and Gezi, who needs to deliver a letter for his grandma, also need to head to Lianhua Town. They strike an agreement with Xiaoqing. Zhang Zhigao, a volunteer teacher concerned about the children’s education, joins the team to rebuild the car. And so begins this pursuit of a dream. United by the resolve to set off, they embark on an extraordinary journey.

title: Bloody Men
overview: In 1980s Sweden, we follow a boy’s love for a mother who tries her best, all the bloody men who come and go, and about not becoming one yourself.

title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
overview: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?

title: A Vision for Vision
overview: Directed and produced by 2x Emmy-award winning filmmaker Wayne Chesler, this special documentary follows Irish nutritional scientist Professor John Nolan’s 20-year exploration of the link between powerful antioxidants - Carotenoids - and their effects on nutrition, vision, and brain health. From the marigold fields of Mexico to research labs in Ireland, the Omega-3 enriched Norwegian seas, and elite performance centers in Singapore, the film uncovers breakthrough science behind these incredible nutrients that support how we see, think, and age.

title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026
overview: The 2026 Crown Jewel, also promoted as Crown Jewel: Riyadh (Arabic: جوهرة التاج: الرياض, romanized: jawharat altaaji: alriyad), is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, to be held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It will be the eighth Crown Jewel and will take place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at an unannounced venue in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of Riyadh Season. This will be the 16th event that WWE will hold in Saudi Arabia under a 10-year partnership in support of Saudi Vision 2030. The event will center around the men's and women's Crown Jewel Championship matches, which will feature the respective men's and women's world champions of Raw and SmackDown against each other to determine the better champion.

overview: Under the oppressive heat of the Spanish sun, the fiercely independent Carmen attracts the attention of Don José. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

overview: Nicolas has come a long way to find Sofiane again. But the meeting, which seemed like it would be simple, doesn’t go as planned. Nicolas moves through this drawn-out day, caught between what was promised and what is still to come.

title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!

title: A Place to Heal
overview: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

title: Afterpiece
overview: Owen, a once prestigious and acclaimed stage director, has fallen into depression after more than a decade of creative drought. His ex-lover Su Manling comes back into his life leveraging their old romance, whereas his wife Tracy hovers on the verge of crossing the marital line. Eager to reclaim his dignity, he resolves to write, direct and perform in a brand-new play. However, while holding open auditions for the leading actress, he is powerfully drawn to amateur newcomer Hannah, slowly slipping into a dangerous grey area where stage drama intertwines with real life.

title: Dead Howling
overview: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

overview: The day of the funeral of the patriarch of the Mancuso family, long-repressed grudges re-emerge between his children Daria and Riccardo. A solemn ceremony reveals the frailties and contradictions of a family that is anything but perfect.

title: Cursed Meme
overview: Yura, a young girl who struggles to fit in with her classmates, discovers an old smartphone while helping clean out a disused school building. Out of curiosity, she and her friends power it on. Soon afterward, strange videos featuring the children themselves begin appearing on their phones. At first, the clips seem like harmless jokes and are consumed much like viral internet memes. What the children do not realize, however, is that these videos are foretelling a horrifying future that awaits them.

title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
overview: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

title: Itllu Arjuna
overview: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

title: Les Duos Impossibles de Jérémy Ferrari : 11ème édition - 1ère partie
original_title: Les Duos Impossibles de Jérémy Ferrari : 11ème édition - 1ère partie

title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
overview: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

title: Festive Fun with Peppa
overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

title: Em & Selma Go Griffin Hunting
overview: In the Depression-ravaged countryside of 1930s America, adolescent girls are expected to fulfill a long-standing rite in which they hunt and slay a mythical beast of their mother’s choosing.

title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の海底鬼岩城
overview: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

title: A Royal Christmas Tail
overview: When a dashing prince trades a glass slipper for a dog tag, he embarks on a heartwarming Christmas quest to find the mysterious woman — and her adorable pup — who captured his heart in one magical holiday moment.

title: Sukdulan
overview: Elaine, trapped in a dysfunctional sexual life with Orly, discovers thrill in an illicit affair with the playboy, Miguel.

title: Andrea Bocelli - The Celebration：30th Anniversary
overview: Filmed at the Teatro del Silenzio (Theatre of Silence) in Lajatico over three nights in 2024 and marking his 30th year as an artist, this once-in-a-lifetime event sees classical star Andrea Bocelli appear in his home of Tuscany with a star-studded lineup of special guests to perform songs that have been the pillars of his career. This 4-disc package features two shows – “The Celebration” and “30 Years of Musical Inspiration” and over 4 and a half hours of performances.  Bocelli is joined by an 80-piece orchestra, a cast of over 200 musicians and family and friends including Ed Sheeran, Jon Batiste, Shania Twain, Brian May and more. It’s a night that transforms both the landscape and beautiful Tuscan sky into something totally spectacular. The result: a mesmerising and truly unforgettable concert.

title: Dot to Dot: Will I Be Single Forever?
original_title: てんてん　ずっと独身でいるつもり？
overview: Misaki Yamada, 30 and single, has no clear ambitions. After drifting between jobs and places, she works as a care worker until trouble in love and work upends her life. Shiba, 38, avoids close relationships, but takes in his nephew and slowly bonds with him through Yamada. Shimizu, 46, faces caring for her father after years of putting work first. All three search for where they belong.

title: Parky
overview: How did a miner’s son from working-class Yorkshire, who rose to become television’s greatest interviewer and die a knighted Sir, never truly believe in himself? A revelatory portrait of Michael Parkinson – the man behind the ‘Parky’ icon as told in his own words and from those closest to him.

title: Terrestrial
overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

title: Ah Girl
overview: In 1994 Singapore, a perceptive seven-year-old girl navigating the aftermath of her parents' marital dissolution faces a severe existential crisis when her erratic, estranged mother offers an unstable proposal for custody, permanently altering the child's perception of domestic normalcy.

title: Traveler's Hell
overview: On an isolated road late at night, a young woman, driving alone, comes across a stranded male driver whose car has broken down on a mountain road notorious for disappearances and murders. Choosing empathy over a creeping sense of foreboding, she offers him a ride to the nearest station. That single choice unleashes a harrowing chain of strange and terrifying events in the dead of night, turning a simple gesture of kindness into a real-life nightmare.

title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
overview: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

title: Gupi and the King Who Doesn't Smile
overview: Gupi and her friends enter an abandoned apartment in their building to deliver a cake. By passing through a closet in one of the rooms, they find themselves in a dark, unhappy, and otherworldly dimension. This place is home to the palace of the King Who Does Not Smile, whose sorrow has spread across the entire realm. Realizing that the inhabitants of this dimension have lost their joy because the King never smiles, Gupi begins trying various methods to restore happiness to the kingdom.

title: The Man Who Could Have Changed the World
original_title: The Man Who Could Have Changed the World
overview: Based upon the true story of Ranuccio Bandinelli, an antifascist Archaeology and History of Art teacher who sought to steer clear of politics but who found himself appointed, ex-officio, as Hitler and Mussolini’s official guide during their visit to Rome and Florence.

title: The Heritage
overview: Árpi (known to his sons simply as “Boss”) has been living alone for years after losing his wife, with whom he spent more than fifty years. In recent months, Árpi has spent practically all of his savings. His two sons, Attila and Kristóf, only realize this when the old man’s electricity is cut off due to his accumulated debt. This is more than strange for the elderly man, who lives a modest life, but he refuses to say a word about where the one and a half million forints went. Attila and Kristóf work together to coax the truth out of him: he gave the money to Hajnalka, a young woman with a difficult past. But who is this Hajnalka, whom they’ve never heard of before? The old man claims he’s in love. The boys claim the old man is being taken advantage of. Everyone clings to their own version of the truth. But the truth must be uncovered. The longest night of their lives begins. And even Hajnalka appears at the front door.

title: Amsterdamned II
overview: After 37 years, the canals of Amsterdam are once again turning blood red. Tara Lee is a young ambitious detective with the Amsterdam police force who is confronted by a number of gruesome incidents around the canals. She enlists the help of  Visser, a retired detective who once nabbed a serial killer stalking those same canals. They face an adversary who seems to possess superhuman powers.

title: Postcards for Christmas
overview: Hannah Norton moves to Mistletoe Valley for the holidays to work at the post office alongside her best friend from college. She discovers that the post office is full of undeliverable mail, including several love letters from the same man. Hannah sets out to solve the mystery - with the help of Ford Montgomery, a DJ at a local radio station.

title: Spring in Imroz
overview: The narrative follows the emotional journey of two distinct individuals whose paths unexpectedly cross on the island, forcing them to confront the heavy shadows of their pasts while discovering the profound possibility of a "second spring" or love being reborn.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
overview: Taylor Lewis, a single father and expert in holiday displays, moves to the picturesque town of Pineway with his two children just weeks before Christmas. While the family adjusts to a new home and school, Taylor also faces the realization that his teenage daughter may be growing out of some of their treasured Christmas traditions.  When Taylor becomes involved in reviving Pineway's Christmas Market, he's paired with Sophie Shaw, a practical accountant eager to prove herself as a potential leader. Their different approaches soon complement each other, bringing new life and festive spirit to the town.  As Taylor tries to hold onto the Christmas traditions his family once shared, he discovers that meaningful moments can't simply be recreated. Growing closer to Sophie along the way, he begins to see that embracing change can lead to new traditions, new memories, and perhaps an unexpected new beginning.

title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
original_title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
overview: Anakin Skywalker, a young slave strong with the Force, is discovered on Tatooine. Meanwhile, the evil Sith have returned, enacting their plot for revenge against the Jedi.

title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider
overview: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.

title: All for Christmas
overview: Podcaster Winona is forced to test love online by a holiday dating-app partnership, connecting with a mystery man who feels like everything she’s been missing. What she doesn’t know is that he’s Luke, the rugged renovator transforming her grandmother’s Christmas Eve venue — and the last guy she’d ever expect to fall for in real life.

title: One Eye Open
overview: A recent college graduate house-sitting for her ailing grandfather finds herself caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with thieves who become haunted by something supernatural protecting her in the mysterious mansion.

title: Double Freedom
overview: Misael works alone with his axe, cutting down trees in the woods. An unexpected responsibility upends his life, and the logic of his days fades away in a nature where human reason holds no meaning.

title: Psycho Side Chick
overview: After being dumped by her married lover, a crazed woman fights to win him back and will get rid of anyone who stands in her way.

title: Lilo & Scratch
overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

title: Hasip and Nasip
overview: In a town named "Hasımlar", the mayoralty has alternated between Hasip and Nasip for years. But when their childhood sweetheart Perihan returns to town and a third candidate emerges, the established order between the two old friends is disrupted. Both Hasip and Nasip, wanting to win the mayoralty and Perihan's heart, throw the town into turmoil with their increasingly malicious election promises and traps.

title: The Ugly Stepsister
overview: In a fairy-tale kingdom where beauty is a brutal business, Elvira battles to compete with her incredibly beautiful stepsister, Agnes, and she will go to any length to catch the Prince’s eye.

title: Good Fortune
overview: A well-meaning but rather inept angel named Gabriel meddles in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy capitalist.

title: Red Sonja
overview: A young girl rises from the ashes of tragedy to become the most feared warrior woman of all time: the She-Devil with a Sword.

title: SAYANG
overview: Nancy, an Indian-descended mother, returns to her hometown and opens a sign language school while caring for her son Ajay, who lives with both hearing impairment and a neurological condition. Among her students are Mina, a Malay girl determined to become a Muay Thai boxer despite cultural expectations, and Sansan, a Chinese girl deeply bound to the ocean she loves. Along the vast coastline, three families and three children navigate faith, identity, and freedom, until their intertwined lives become a moving symphony of resilience and love.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

title: Love Lessons
overview: On the eve of retirement, Émile delivers one final lesson about love and literature, urging his students to become the poets of their own lives. But is he still in love himself? Unable to answer, he returns home only to discover that his wife has left him. Émile must now live by the very words he’s been preaching, and thanks to unexpected encounters his life is turned upside down, helping him to reinvent himself.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

title: Reporting Live
overview: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

title: A Long Winter
overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

title: Family Wanted
overview: The film revolves around Farouk (Karim Abdel Aziz), a supermarket manager who is too busy to attend to his home, his wife Mai (Yasmine Sabri), and his children. His wife’s unemployed brother, Galal (Mostafa Khater), moves in with the family, completely turning Farouk's life upside down and dragging him into seemingly unsolvable predicaments—all set against a backdrop of comedy.

title: All About Corinne
overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

title: Last Chance Motel
overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

title: Go for Broke 2
overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

title: Gintama the Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames
original_title: 新劇場版 銀魂 -吉原大炎上-
overview: Upon meeting a young boy named Seita who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hinowa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Seita's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

title: First Voice
original_title: ファーストボイス ー私たちの逆転裁判ー
overview: In 1989, when workplace sexual harassment was rarely recognized as a legal issue in Japan, lawyer Michiko Asahi takes on an unprecedented case after office worker Megumi Uehara seeks to sue her company and supervisor over harassment that cost her her job. Despite a rookie lawyer's warning that the case has virtually no chance of success, Asahi believes their fight could change the future. Facing a legal system and society firmly rooted in conventional attitudes, the women risk their careers and reputations to challenge the status quo and make their voices heard.

title: The Last First: Winter K2
overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

title: Lottie Dottie Chicken: The Movie
overview: When a clumsy stork mixed up the eggs during delivery, Lottie Dottie Chicken's first egg ends up in the nest of a fearsome hawk in the mountains.

title: The Influencer Project
overview: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

title: Avaraachan & Sons
overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

title: Conjurig
overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

title: Molière, Cyrano and the Young King
overview: During the Paris rebellion, young Louis XIV must be hidden from danger and is secretly replaced at court by a look-alike. Entrusted to the musketeer-poet Cyrano de Bergerac, Louis is sheltered within Madeleine Béjart’s traveling theater troupe, where the actor and aspiring playwright Molière has just joined – unaware their newest member is the future king of France. As Cyrano struggles to handle the arrogant and clumsy young king, he begins writing a bold play for the troupe. Molière, bursting with ideas, transforms the work with wit and heart, awakening his genius for comedy and deepening his secret feelings for Madeleine, while young Louis discovers the joy of theater and the power of friendship. But back in Paris, intrigue is brewing – can the young king return in time before the masquerade is revealed and embrace his true royal destiny?

title: Traces of Justice
overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

title: Clarissa
overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

title: Earthlings in Love
original_title: 恋する地球人 -劇場特別版-
overview: In 2000, high schooler Shinpei asks his crush, Mai, to star in his first film. In 2025, now a director, he lives with young-onset dementia.

title: The Four: No One Fights Alone
original_title: The Four: No One Fights Alone
overview: Shifting from her usual comedic angles to an emotionally charged, character-driven drama, the narrative revolves around Esosa and three fiercely loyal women. When a high-stakes crisis threatens the future of a young man they collectively love, their courage, faith, and mutual bonds are pushed to unimaginable limits.

title: Titanic
overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.

title: Top Gun
overview: For Lieutenant Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick 'Goose' Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy, as well as personal demons, will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: A Girl’s Story
overview: During a book signing in Normandy, Annie Ernaux, 70, revisits her memories of the summer of 1958, when she was 17. That summer, she left her hometown to work as a camp counsellor. At the first party, the head counsellor set out to deflower her. Finding him handsome, she lets him do it, as if against her will... Her body becomes a foreign place for her, an offering to be sacrificed.

title: Sunshine on the Road
overview: Unable to continue caring for their mother, who is suffering from dementia, a family embarks on one final trip together. During the journey, a long-buried family secret quietly surfaces, forever changing their understanding of one another.

title: Forte
overview: Young composer Yeonji lands her dream job at the prestigious and isolated Forte Studio that soon reveals itself as an unsettling work environment because of the eerie atmosphere around there and odd behaviors from her colleagues and boss. But Yeonji’s fierce ambition doesn’t allow her to give up and, when she realizes that her boss uses her as a mere ghostwriter, the competitive spirit between the two arises until it escalates into a matter of life and death.

title: Halloween Candy 2
overview: One year after surviving a Halloween massacre, Candee faces a new nightmare when a masked killer traps her and her friends inside a house where every secret is deadly. As the body count rises, she'll learn that the true monsters aren’t always the ones wearing masks.

title: The Nice Ones
overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

title: I Know Who You Are
overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

title: The Old Dog
overview: A homicide, a massive outstanding debt, a short-selling scheme - it all stems from a seemingly unremarkable yet highly suspicious theft. Jing Youzheng, a police officer nearing retirement, senses something amiss; as the investigation deepens, every clue points toward Bian Juhan, Chairman of the Mingdian Group. The veteran officer relentlessly pursues the case and takes the offensive, while Chairman Bian launches a counterattack. What is the actual truth? Amidst this clash between good and evil, what kind of high-stakes drama will unfold between these two adversaries?

title: The Rough Patch
overview: Ben, a gifted skater with a crush on the school's queen bee, and Lionel, his bold but clueless best friend, chase popularity in their final year...until a run-in with a local drug lord makes them wish for their old lives back.

title: Premada Oorali
overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: The Vvaan
overview: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that not only do some powers exist beyond logic but he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: Long Day's Journey into Night
overview: Over the course of a day, a married couple, Mary and James Tyrone, and their two sons, Jamie and Edmund, grapple with Mary's morphine addiction and confront each other over the past in a series of emotionally tense and volatile exchanges.

title: 100 Days
overview: 100 Days is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: For Better And For Worse
overview: A group of friends, and the power of memory.

title: The French Teacher
overview: Graça, a lesbian woman living in Belo Horizonte with her French girlfriend Clara, gives private French lessons to support herself in a large Brazilian metropolis. As an independent Black woman from a lower-middle-class background, she finds herself confronted by the dark side of religious fanaticism when she is forced to live with an extremist evangelical family that gradually involves her in a mysterious plot that leads her to lose her mind.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: Rebuilding
overview: After wildfires take his ranch, a cowboy named Dusty winds up in a FEMA camp, finding community with others who lost homes, including his daughter and ex-wife.

title: Solo Mio
overview: After Matt's dreams of a picturesque Italian wedding are shattered when his fiancée leaves him at the altar, he embarks on his planned honeymoon across Italy alone, immersing himself in the country's vibrant culture, food, and beauty, meeting Gia along the way.

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2
overview: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on September 19, 2026, at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, United States. A UFC Flyweight Championship rematch between current champion Joshua Van and former champion Alexandre Pantoja headlined the event. They previously competed in December 2025 at UFC 323, where Van won the belt via technical knockout 26 seconds into the first round as a result of an arm injury sustained by Pantoja.

title: Play House
overview: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired children’s show that begins to invade his life and threaten his chance at reconciliation.

title: Derek vs Derek
overview: The idyllic English countryside. An intensive dairy farmer called Derek. One day his neighbour, also called Derek, forsakes farming tradition and starts to turn his land over to wild nature. How does the community react when one of it’s own turns his back on their way of life?

title: Lust Stories 3
overview: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

title: Feel the dead
overview: An extraordinary tale of friendship and survival.  After a DEADLY VIRUS is unleashed upon the world, three friends must fight for their lives, travel through dense forests filled with danger, and find a cure before it's too late.

title: Daayra
overview: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

title: 5 cm: Revolusi Hati
overview: Four inseparable companions pledge lifelong solidarity upon entering secondary education, only for their collective bond to undergo severe emotional and structural strain when the introduction of romantic interests and an transformative journey outside the metropolis force them to confront the inevitable realities of maturity.

title: Everything Else Is Noise
overview: Rosa, a contemporary music composer, agrees to give her first television interview at her colleague Tere’s apartment to keep it secret from her husband. What begins as a simple professional conversation turns into an absurd and comic portrait of rivalries and affections among three women—Rosa, Tere, and Tere’s daughter Luisa—interrupted by power outages, a constantly barking dog, and the visit of a famous composer. As the interview unravels, family and artistic tensions surface, revealing, with humor, both the fragility of prestige and the strength of complicity.

title: Blade Runner
overview: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.

title: WHY, IF
overview: Novelist Ji-man moves to a quiet village with his wife Soo-yeong, but he soon spirals into a dangerous obsession as suspicious clues about her surface. Following an irreversible tragedy, his supposedly dead wife mysteriously reappears, shattering his entire perception of reality. This gripping Korean psychological thriller will keep you guessing until the final second: is what he believes the truth, or a lie?

title: Thirteen in Gaza
overview: Palestinian director Hosam Abu Dan makes his narrative feature debut with a nuanced and deeply human portrait of a father and his teenage daughter navigating everyday life in a refugee camp in the Gaza Strip.

title: Avatar
overview: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization.

title: Extra-mourningg
overview: Since the 2022 Itaewon Halloween tragedy, social mourning has failed to reach the margins. Within this silence, stories unfold from those who hesitate yet strive to respond in their own ways. While documenting them, I drift among them too, and find that the sites of mourning hold no place for people like me. Fragmented stories are continually rewritten into three loosely defined parts, like a messy cluster of sticky notes.

title: 100 Days
overview: 100 Days is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: For Better And For Worse
overview: A group of friends, and the power of memory.

title: The French Teacher
overview: Graça, a lesbian woman living in Belo Horizonte with her French girlfriend Clara, gives private French lessons to support herself in a large Brazilian metropolis. As an independent Black woman from a lower-middle-class background, she finds herself confronted by the dark side of religious fanaticism when she is forced to live with an extremist evangelical family that gradually involves her in a mysterious plot that leads her to lose her mind.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: Rebuilding
overview: After wildfires take his ranch, a cowboy named Dusty winds up in a FEMA camp, finding community with others who lost homes, including his daughter and ex-wife.

title: Solo Mio
overview: After Matt's dreams of a picturesque Italian wedding are shattered when his fiancée leaves him at the altar, he embarks on his planned honeymoon across Italy alone, immersing himself in the country's vibrant culture, food, and beauty, meeting Gia along the way.

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2
overview: UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on September 19, 2026, at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, United States. A UFC Flyweight Championship rematch between current champion Joshua Van and former champion Alexandre Pantoja headlined the event. They previously competed in December 2025 at UFC 323, where Van won the belt via technical knockout 26 seconds into the first round as a result of an arm injury sustained by Pantoja.

title: Play House
overview: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired children’s show that begins to invade his life and threaten his chance at reconciliation.

title: Derek vs Derek
overview: The idyllic English countryside. An intensive dairy farmer called Derek. One day his neighbour, also called Derek, forsakes farming tradition and starts to turn his land over to wild nature. How does the community react when one of it’s own turns his back on their way of life?

title: Lust Stories 3
overview: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

title: Lord of War
overview: Yuri Orlov is a globetrotting arms dealer and, through some of the deadliest war zones, he struggles to stay one step ahead of a relentless Interpol agent, his business rivals and even some of his customers who include many of the world's most notorious dictators. Finally, he must also face his own conscience.

title: Feel the dead
overview: An extraordinary tale of friendship and survival.  After a DEADLY VIRUS is unleashed upon the world, three friends must fight for their lives, travel through dense forests filled with danger, and find a cure before it's too late.

title: Daayra
overview: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

title: 5 cm: Revolusi Hati
overview: Four inseparable companions pledge lifelong solidarity upon entering secondary education, only for their collective bond to undergo severe emotional and structural strain when the introduction of romantic interests and an transformative journey outside the metropolis force them to confront the inevitable realities of maturity.

title: Everything Else Is Noise
overview: Rosa, a contemporary music composer, agrees to give her first television interview at her colleague Tere’s apartment to keep it secret from her husband. What begins as a simple professional conversation turns into an absurd and comic portrait of rivalries and affections among three women—Rosa, Tere, and Tere’s daughter Luisa—interrupted by power outages, a constantly barking dog, and the visit of a famous composer. As the interview unravels, family and artistic tensions surface, revealing, with humor, both the fragility of prestige and the strength of complicity.
