title: Selma
overview: Neslihan, an unsuccessful actress, and her social media influencer friends break into the home of Selma—a woman suffering from Alzheimer’s—to secretly live-stream her for profit. As their viewership surges, the house begins to reveal its terrifying secrets, and the young women find themselves trapped in a lethal Dark Web show. Now, Neslihan must decide just how far she is willing to go to escape poverty and achieve fame.

title: The Last Dance In Kippur
overview: ON OCTOBER 6, 1973, THE EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES CHALLENGED THOSE EXPECTATIONS AND CHANGED THE COURSE OF HISTORY.  THE LAST DANCE IN KIPPUR IS A CINEMATIC RECREATION OF THE CRITICAL HOURS LEADING UP TO THE OCTOBER WAR, EXPLORING MILITARY STRATEGY, INTELLIGENCE, DECEPTION, AND THE EXTRAORDINARY COURAGE OF THE EGYPTIAN SOLDIER.

title: Amarte
overview: He lives in his own universe. She is a famous soap opera star who needs to disappear from hers. When they meet by accident, what seems like a bad idea becomes a getaway as absurd as it is irresistible. As they flee from the press, between increasingly out of place situations, delirious moments and a connection that no one saw coming, both discover that escaping from reality can be much more fun... and dangerously irresistible for the heart. But when the real world reaches them again, they will have to decide if that encounter was just a perfect fantasy or if it is worth the risk of experiencing something real.

title: Bibliographie
overview: Janja Garnbret has nothing left to prove indoors—two Olympic golds, and more World Cup victories than any climber alive. So she heads to Céüse to attempt Bibliographie, one of the hardest routes on Earth, to discover just how far she can push herself. But when her summer project stretches into a grueling, multi-year odyssey, the woman who is used to winning is forced to confront her weaknesses like never before.

title: Reel Rock 20 Retrospective Film
overview: A short film played at the beginning of Reel Rock 20.

title: One Minute
overview: During a brief stop in the heart of a forest, Selvan, a Tamil migrant bound for England, finds himself stranded in France with no landmarks or resources. Left to wander an unfamiliar city whose language he does not speak, he drifts between hope and panic, facing silence, suspicion, and rare glimmers of humanity. Oru Nimidam (One Minute) captures, over a compressed timeline, the intimate downward spiral of an ordinary man whose life suddenly hangs in the balance revealing the invisible violence of borders and the vulnerability of those who cross them.

title: The Project
overview: An Afro-Brazilian filmmaker and a Swiss-Serbian photographer embark on a personal and political journey to confront the colonial mindset that still shapes relationships in today’s world. From Brazil, one of the most unequal countries marked by structural racism, to Switzerland, one of the richest and most privileged nations, they face uncomfortable questions: how can a Black woman thrive in a society built on racism? And how do you decolonize the mind when you’ve grown up surrounded by privilege? In search of answers, they dive into transformative conversations with inspiring voices around the world, while reflecting on their own contradictions, complicities, and hopes.

title: Fogaréu
overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

title: Menang Untuk Kalah
overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.

title: The Rainbow Fish
overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.

title: Echo Chamber
overview: An exploration in narcissistic desire, a kind of autoeroticopsis in being the subject of desire for yourself.

title: Our Holiday Playbook
overview: When Lexi Bell returns home for the holidays, she faces a beloved family tradition she'd rather avoid: the fiercely competitive Bell Bowl, an annual Christmas flag football showdown between her father and uncle that has fueled decades of sibling rivalry. But when an injury sidelines her brother-in-law, it looks like Lexi's family's losing streak will remain unbroken. To give them a fighting chance, she strikes a deal with Eddie, a former local football star-turned teacher: Lexi will use her baking know-how to help Eddie best his brother in their annual bake-off if he'll pose as her boyfriend and meet the "eligibility requirement" to play on their team. As they navigate each other's festive family gatherings, traditions and celebrations, what started as a transactional partnership begins to become something more as Lexi and Eddie find themselves feeling less and less like their romantic relationship is just pretend.

title: I Am Going to Miss You
original_title: Eu Vou Ter Saudades de Você
overview: Amanda and Caio are a trans couple who share seven years of love and dreams. However, when they decide to live together, the differences between them begin to take their toll.

title: MEN TOO
overview: A man struggles to stay strong after a painful divorce, moving through his days with a quiet loneliness that no one notices. This PSA explores how a single moment of genuine care can change everything for someone who feels forgotten.

title: The Body in the Locker
overview: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

title: The Fire Within You
original_title: Il fuoco che ti porti dentro
overview: Antonio, who fled Naples many years ago, has built a family and a successful career in Milan, far from his mother Angela — a woman excessive in both her virtues and her flaws, irresistible, old-fashioned and hostile like few others — who has come to visit for Christmas and seems determined to stay.  Christmas Eve dinner becomes an emotional battlefield, at once comic and fierce, bringing to the surface a past of impositions and misunderstandings. With a stubborn capon that refuses to end up in the pot, a daughter whose arrival remains uncertain, and an unexpected distinguished guest, the evening turns into a reckoning between mother and son destined to change the meaning of their bond forever: a love that burns like a fire within, one that never dies out — not even by leaving.

title: Naa Wife Missing
overview: A newly married couple's happy life takes a mysterious turn when the wife suddenly disappears. As the husband seeks help, doubts about her past and hidden secrets begin to surface.

title: Crypto
overview: The story revolves around an Italian mafia family that contacts the two sons of its late leader, who are living in Egypt, to inform them of their inheritance rights. However, two Egyptian men impersonate the heirs and travel to Italy, where they find themselves caught up in a series of unexpected situations and complications.

title: Sh*t Happens
overview: When their nine-year-old daughter falls mysteriously ill, a wealthy Dominican couple turns to an experimental treatment created from their housemaid Liddy's feces, without her knowledge. Once Liddy and her colleague Dominga discover the truth, they seize the opportunity to turn the household’s power dynamics upside down.

title: The Girl with the Leica
overview: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

title: Beyond the Smiles: Yani Tseng
overview: This film follows the historic and unparalleled rise, fall, and epic comeback of global golf icon Yani TSENG, who returns to the golf course, faces twists and challenges, and embarks on a quest to explore her life’s purpose in 2024.

title: Malika
overview: A biopic of Malika Bellaribi, a French-Algerian woman who grew up in the Parisian projects, who survived trauma and ultimately achieved her dream of becoming a renowned lyrical singer.

title: The Cruelty Baha Blast
overview: three doctors must find a cure for their poisoned friend when things take a suspicious turn.

title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

title: The Search for Milliseconds
overview: Inside mountain bike downhill phenom Jackson Goldstone's high-stakes bid to become one of the youngest riders in history to claim the UCI DH Elite overall title. From pre-season testing to the tense, pressure-filled moments leading into the last race of the year, the film follows Jackson and the team that supports him as they hunt for every possible edge in a sport where the smallest fractions of time can define a champion. With the title on the line and only one decisive run remaining, Jackson prepares to risk everything for the win.

title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
overview: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

title: Reel Rock 20
overview: Reel Rock 20 World Tour showcases the world's best climbing stories: Olympic champion Janja Garnbret sets her sights on the legendary climb Bibliographie, Michaela Kiersch goes on a global sending spree, Ben Mayforth redefines adaptive climbing in his intense pursuit of 5.13, and Colin Haley attempts an historic solo winter ascent of Cerro Torre.

title: Amazing Monster
original_title: アメイジング・モンスター
overview: Maria comes from a sacred family and wants to become a miko in her village of Appare. When a secret that has been kept hidden for 18 years is revealed, a mysterious power awakens within her.

title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

title: The Last Dance In Kippur
overview: ON OCTOBER 6, 1973, THE EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES CHALLENGED THOSE EXPECTATIONS AND CHANGED THE COURSE OF HISTORY.  THE LAST DANCE IN KIPPUR IS A CINEMATIC RECREATION OF THE CRITICAL HOURS LEADING UP TO THE OCTOBER WAR, EXPLORING MILITARY STRATEGY, INTELLIGENCE, DECEPTION, AND THE EXTRAORDINARY COURAGE OF THE EGYPTIAN SOLDIER.

title: Amarte
overview: He lives in his own universe. She is a famous soap opera star who needs to disappear from hers. When they meet by accident, what seems like a bad idea becomes a getaway as absurd as it is irresistible. As they flee from the press, between increasingly out of place situations, delirious moments and a connection that no one saw coming, both discover that escaping from reality can be much more fun... and dangerously irresistible for the heart. But when the real world reaches them again, they will have to decide if that encounter was just a perfect fantasy or if it is worth the risk of experiencing something real.

title: Inside Out 2
overview: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

title: Bibliographie
overview: Janja Garnbret has nothing left to prove indoors—two Olympic golds, and more World Cup victories than any climber alive. So she heads to Céüse to attempt Bibliographie, one of the hardest routes on Earth, to discover just how far she can push herself. But when her summer project stretches into a grueling, multi-year odyssey, the woman who is used to winning is forced to confront her weaknesses like never before.

title: Reel Rock 20 Retrospective Film
overview: A short film played at the beginning of Reel Rock 20.

title: One Minute
overview: During a brief stop in the heart of a forest, Selvan, a Tamil migrant bound for England, finds himself stranded in France with no landmarks or resources. Left to wander an unfamiliar city whose language he does not speak, he drifts between hope and panic, facing silence, suspicion, and rare glimmers of humanity. Oru Nimidam (One Minute) captures, over a compressed timeline, the intimate downward spiral of an ordinary man whose life suddenly hangs in the balance revealing the invisible violence of borders and the vulnerability of those who cross them.

title: The Project
overview: An Afro-Brazilian filmmaker and a Swiss-Serbian photographer embark on a personal and political journey to confront the colonial mindset that still shapes relationships in today’s world. From Brazil, one of the most unequal countries marked by structural racism, to Switzerland, one of the richest and most privileged nations, they face uncomfortable questions: how can a Black woman thrive in a society built on racism? And how do you decolonize the mind when you’ve grown up surrounded by privilege? In search of answers, they dive into transformative conversations with inspiring voices around the world, while reflecting on their own contradictions, complicities, and hopes.

title: Fogaréu
overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

title: Menang Untuk Kalah
overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.

title: The Rainbow Fish
overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.

title: Ghost Rider
overview: In order to save his dying father, young stunt cyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul to Mephistopheles and sadly parts from the pure-hearted Roxanne Simpson, the love of his life. Years later, Johnny's path crosses again with Roxanne, now a go-getting reporter, and also with Mephistopheles, who offers to release Johnny's soul if Johnny becomes the fabled, fiery 'Ghost Rider'.

title: Rent: 30th Anniversary Concert
overview: Original cast members and a bevy of special guests revive the Tony Award- and Pulitzer Prize-winning rock musical sensation Rent in a gala concert celebration for the show’s 30th anniversary. The one-night-only concert of the full show will take place on Monday, October 26, at Broadway’s Richard Rodgers Theatre as a benefit for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.

title: Eat My Cookie!
overview: Two brosphere vloggers invite previous channel og Hayden for a special camping reunion episode, but sanctity of boys trip is threatened when he brings his girlfriend. Together they'll discover what happens when you give a bro a cookie.

title: Untasted
overview: Zad, an alien foodie from the Cluster of Raa, brings his family to prehistoric Earth on a quest to taste something no Raaian has tasted before. But when his daughter forms a strange connection with a human cave child, it puts a dent in Zad’s plans for dinner.

title: What If Christmas
overview: Erin has always supported her husband Adam, a heart surgeon, by organizing the hospitals' Christmas charity galas. However, when he moves to a new hospital, her help is no longer needed. Feeling lost and without a purpose back in New York City, her long-suppressed regrets over giving up her dream of pursuing fashion design start bubbling up. When Erin is given a peculiar heart-shaped Christmas ornament, she wakes up in an alternate reality where she's a world-famous fashion designer. As she "meets" and attends Christmas events with alternate-universe Adam, she realizes that while her fashion dreams came true, it's lonely at the top. While working on a way to bring more charity and heart to her fashion empire, she learns that her dream life and love were always right in front of her – if only she finds the heart and courage to ask.

title: Bread of Hope
overview: The life of Nazan, who runs the small town bakery "Tatlı Maya" (Bread of Hope) all on her own, changes when a young Syrian woman named Rana walks through her door. Already in labor, Rana gives birth to her baby inside the bakery. Having lost her husband, been evicted from her home, and left with nowhere else to go, Rana is taken in by Nazan—first into her own home, and later into the bakery. As a quiet bond forms between the two women amidst the rhythms of daily life, rumors begin to spread and intensify throughout the town. Fueled in part by Sami—a man who has long harbored an interest in Nazan—these prejudices lead customers to abandon the bakery, eventually resulting in the authorities sealing off "Tatlı Maya" on the grounds that Rana was being employed there illegally. Nazan begins to pay a heavy price for the decision she made.

title: Skindiei: The Thirteenth Floor
overview: A person records their experiences on a cruise ship.

title: The End of Nowhere
overview: A grieving woman wanders the beautiful and mysterious West Texas desert in her car searching for answers in the surreal and supernatural phenomenon known as "The Lights."

title: The Lost Plot
overview: Artur is a stand-up comedian who plans to turn his life around and write a book about the story of a female guerrilla fighter from the 1970s. He gets mugged and his computer containing his drafts is stolen, but an app takes photos of the people using the stolen computer and emails them to him.

title: Mimosa
overview: In a utopian world where happiness is absolute, a suicide crisis threatens the very existence of humanity. As countless lives are lost and the global happiness index continues to decline, the AI Government assigns Mimosa the mission of restoring happiness and bringing population growth back to the world.  By chance, Mimosa encounters Ash, a man laughing at an advertisement featuring her face. Upon discovering that his happiness level is far below that of everyone else, she sets out to cure him. But as she delves deeper into Ash’s condition, Mimosa uncovers a key that could change the fate of their world forever.

title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
overview: This cinema presentation brings BTS’s Buenos Aires concert to the big screen, marking the group’s first performance in Argentina and its first live viewing broadcast from South America. Audiences can experience the explosive atmosphere of a packed stadium in a 195-minute event, with some territories receiving a time-shifted screening.

title: Heathens
overview: A groundbreaking 2024 University of Chicago study, presented at the Society for the Scientific Study of Religion, has uncovered something stunning: more than 50 million American Christians now conceal private doubts about their faith—a quiet crisis of doubt hidden behind Sunday smiles. This nationally representative research—the first of its kind—reveals the emotional and social toll of concealment: anxiety, shame, family rupture, and the quiet unraveling of identity in communities where belief defines belonging.

title: Killer Card
overview: A former addict fighting for a new life is pulled back into darkness when a shadowy manipulator targets her deepest fears. As a mysterious card triggers a chain of psychological horrors, Elisa must confront her past before it destroys everything she's built.

title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
overview: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

title: ENHYPEN WORLD TOUR 'BLOOD SAGA'
overview: ENHYPEN’s ongoing world tour ‘BLOOD SAGA’ continues to captivate audiences around the world. Relive the unforgettable Seoul concert that marked the beginning of the ‘BLOOD SAGA’, where a mesmerizing dark fantasy comes to life. The members' fierce, synchronized choreography and a spectacular, breathtaking stage design emerge from the red glow and deep darkness. Experience the intense band-style sound and the unrivaled vampire universe that only ENHYPEN can deliver in cinemas!

title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
overview: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

title: Orang Minyak
overview: Rayyan reluctantly spends his 16th birthday at the beach. When he suddenly finds oil stains on his body, he becomes convinced that a mysterious entity is stalking him.

title: Caballé
overview: The beloved opera star Montserrat Caballé faces a challenge that takes her back to the beginning of her career.

title: Capturing Bigfoot
overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

title: Best Pancakes in the County
overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe - Part 1
original_title: 装甲騎兵ボトムズ 灰色の魔女 第1作
overview: A never-ending battlefield ruled by madness, but there was a witch who would surely rise again.

title: The Terminal List Season Two Premiere
original_title: The Terminal List Season Two Premiere
overview: The Terminal List, Season Two finds James Reece searching for new purpose after finishing his list. But when the CIA corners him, Reece must clear his name by stopping a resurgent terrorist group that has turned Reece's former ally to their cause. In this globe-trotting espionage thriller, Reece will uncover a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley, even to his own family's history.

title: Battle Through the Heavens Movie：Duel of the Two Dou Emperors
original_title: 斗破苍穹剧场版 双帝之战

title: Big Boys Don't Cry
overview: A camera enters the hypermasculine world of bouncers and bodybuilders in Cairo. Beneath the layers of performance and sculpted bodies, is it able to reach a core that is humane and vulnerable?

title: The Lumins
overview: The journey of felt Arra, Bebe and Gigi coming to life.

title: Broken Path
overview: When a young Navajo woman returns to her childhood home, she's surprised to cross paths with her estranged older brother. A simple visit soon spirals into a long-avoided confrontation that forces both siblings to face the past they've been running from.

title: #Vymara
overview: Four washed-up creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a conspiracy and uncover a sinister truth never meant to go viral.

title: Mother, There’s a Star in Me
original_title: ម៉ែអើយ ផ្កាយរះក្នុងខ្លួនកូន
overview: This 65 min documentary feature an all-female drumming troop, Medha, from Siem Reap, Cambodia who symbolizes resilience and empowerment. Through powerful performances and intimate glimpses into their daily lives, the film sheds light on their courage to pursue their passion for the arts while navigating societal challenges, advocating for women’s rights, and raising their children as single mothers. This documentary not only celebrates the strength of remarkable women but also highlights the transformative power of music, exploring its deep, hereditary roots.

title: Death Came Knocking
overview: In the summer of 1978, two cousins are trapped inside their childhood home by a group of strangers. As the night continues, survival slowly turns to murder.

title: Mustang
overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.

title: Traqueteo
overview: I look around and observe the landscape. I let myself go because that's all I have left: to listen, to look, to sleep, perhaps to dream. The rattle of the bus moves me.

title: MORELIFE

original_title: Mi casa no es tu casa

overview: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. Alchemy in Venice
overview: In the eclectic world of Venice Beach, three artists searching for purpose find their lives unexpectedly intertwined.

title: The Matriarch
overview: Seventeen-year-old Kim lives with her emotionally distant mother, mute younger brother, and strangers hiding in a secret room in their apartment at the Baltic coast. Vietnamese migrants regularly pass through their home as her mother, a key figure in a criminal network, runs human trafficking operations. When her mother's associate Luc defects to start a rival operation, Kim seizes her chance to prove herself to her mother. She navigates her first romance while entering a clandestine family business. As her good intentions drag her into a dark and brutal underworld that contradicts her sensitive nature, Kim begins to question the true costs of earning respect by crossing her own boundaries.

overview: Silvana "Silvy" Gianetti is disillusioned with her job as the executive chef at a swanky restaurant in New York. Growing up in a large and loving Italian-American family, Silvy is drawn to the food and comfort of her home. When her beloved Nonna suffers a minor wrist injury, Silvy is called back home to Boston's Italian North End to prepare the family's beloved "Feast of the Seven Fishes" Christmas Eve dinner. As she preps for the big feast, her family is joined by Ethan , a photographer who is documenting different family traditions around town and who's become close to her Nonna. After a rocky start with Ethan, things begin to heat up as Silvy grows to appreciate the heart and soul he puts into capturing the magic of the little moments and a romance could be simmering. Every day leading up to Christmas Eve, Silvy gathers in the kitchen with her Nonna, mom and aunt to prepare the pasta, struffoli and other Italian classics near and dear to Silvy's heart.

title: The Most Wonderful Secret
overview: Every Christmas, a small town honors the memory of a beloved teacher — who once spread joy through her "Secret Norma" gifts — by creating a whimsical and heartfelt scavenger hunt for one worthy recipient. When burned-out art teacher Vanessa visits her widowed brother and niece Esther for the holidays, she is surprised to be chosen as the next "Secret Norma" recipient. Hoping to bring Esther some Christmas magic, Vanessa decides to help revive the town's holiday block party. Her handsome electrician neighbor Spencer offers help with the preparations if Vanessa will help him sell his mother Norma's house. As Vanessa solves the riddles of "Secret Norma" and plans the block party, her passion for teaching art begins to spark along with her feelings for the charming electrician next door.

title: Let's Have Kids!
overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

title: The Greatest Christmas Gift
overview: When an unexpected setback threatens their Christmas wedding, Emma and Caleb discover that the greatest gifts are found in faith, selfless love and a community that reminds them to keep believing.

title: Clown Panic
overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

title: Jesus Land
overview: Set between 1980s rural Indiana and a Dominican reform school, a white sister and her adopted black brother fight oppression, prejudice, and rigid dogma to survive.

title: Beach Fictions
overview: On a train, a novelist meets Tae-ju, a young woman who resembles the protagonist of her novel in progress. Tae-ju runs away from damaging rumors to a seaside town. There, she meets Man-hyuk, a street magician, and feels drawn to him—only to hear unsettling rumors about him. Unsure of what to believe, Tae-ju visits a fortune-teller mentioned as being remarkably accurate.

title: Fubei Park
overview: The building is gone. After the fire, they planted flowers and trees. The past lies covered, as if no one had ever lived here. There is no stone. No name to speak. The park grew green, but nothing named who once had been.

title: Leptocephalus
overview: When a bite from an endangered eel starts replacing an unsuspecting scientist’s skin with salt, the scientist must give in to the unstoppable force of transformation. With a muted, earthy color palette, this hopeful short finds peace in the often painful process of becoming something, or someone, new.

title: The Spirit of Halloween
overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

title: Teambuilding 2
overview: After barely surviving a team-building retreat that tested not only their social skills but also their mental health, Horia and the gang are now part of an elite team trying to sell a groundbreaking new product: AI de PLM.

title: Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
original_title: Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
overview: The general public discovered Bilal Hassani during Eurovision 2019 with his song "Roi" (King), a true anthem to diversity that sparked waves of both love and hatred on social media. Very quickly, the young man courageously tackled the question of gender identity in a personal and artistic exploration, not hesitating to share his doubts, his wounds, and his own evolution with us. This documentary sets out to embrace several deeply resonant themes: homosexuality, homophobia, cyberbullying and justice, racism as well as Moroccan roots, love and the choice of a mother who frees herself from cultural weight for her son's fulfillment, celebrity, and of course, identity and gender.

title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
original_title: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第5話
overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Yorushika LIVE: "Tousaku"
overview: A concept live performance by n-buna, combining recitation and musical performance, held from September to October 2025.  This video features footage from Yorushika's LIVE TOUR 2025 "Plagiarism Re-enactment".

title: Gummy
overview: A serial killer goes out one night in search of a new victim and ends up encountering his worst nightmare.

title: Dear Sunshine
overview: Na-yeon, a nurse who works night shifts, can sleep during the day. But there are days when she cannot.

title: Hinotama: Ball of Fire
overview: As his parents' marriage fractures and eventually collapses into divorce, high schooler Takeshi becomes increasingly obsessed with hunting for a mysterious 'ball of fire' rumored by a childhood friend. Using this quest to escape the quiet turmoil at home, Takeshi leaves his younger brother to shoulder the family's emotional weight without realizing it.

title: Some Detective
overview: Writer Hye-joo is trying her hand at a detective novel for the first time, but things aren’t going as she'd hoped. One day she receives a call from the mother of her ex-husband Tae-jae and sets out, beginning an unfamiliar journey. What follows is a series of encounters, some with people from Hye-joo's past and others arising from relationships in her present. These encounters may have little to do with her original purpose, taking her far off course. On a day she is supposed to meet her boyfriend, for instance, she never sees him and instead finds herself spending time with his son Yul-i and his friend Jong-i.

title: Our Share of Sand
overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

title: Tomorrow's Min-Jae
overview: Min-Jae, a promising athlete, is driven to the edge when a teammate benefits from a wealthy background, and she takes action. When her coach learns her secret, she is offered a deal.

title: Steps
overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

title: These Violent Delights
overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

title: Capturing Bigfoot
overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe - Part 1
original_title: 装甲騎兵ボトムズ 灰色の魔女 第1作
overview: A never-ending battlefield ruled by madness, but there was a witch who would surely rise again.

title: The Terminal List Season Two Premiere
original_title: The Terminal List Season Two Premiere
overview: The Terminal List, Season Two finds James Reece searching for new purpose after finishing his list. But when the CIA corners him, Reece must clear his name by stopping a resurgent terrorist group that has turned Reece's former ally to their cause. In this globe-trotting espionage thriller, Reece will uncover a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley, even to his own family's history.

title: Battle Through the Heavens Movie：Duel of the Two Dou Emperors
original_title: 斗破苍穹剧场版 双帝之战

title: Big Boys Don't Cry
overview: A camera enters the hypermasculine world of bouncers and bodybuilders in Cairo. Beneath the layers of performance and sculpted bodies, is it able to reach a core that is humane and vulnerable?

title: The Lumins
overview: The journey of felt Arra, Bebe and Gigi coming to life.

title: Broken Path
overview: When a young Navajo woman returns to her childhood home, she's surprised to cross paths with her estranged older brother. A simple visit soon spirals into a long-avoided confrontation that forces both siblings to face the past they've been running from.

title: #Vymara
overview: Four washed-up creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a conspiracy and uncover a sinister truth never meant to go viral.

title: Mother, There’s a Star in Me
original_title: ម៉ែអើយ ផ្កាយរះក្នុងខ្លួនកូន
overview: This 65 min documentary feature an all-female drumming troop, Medha, from Siem Reap, Cambodia who symbolizes resilience and empowerment. Through powerful performances and intimate glimpses into their daily lives, the film sheds light on their courage to pursue their passion for the arts while navigating societal challenges, advocating for women’s rights, and raising their children as single mothers. This documentary not only celebrates the strength of remarkable women but also highlights the transformative power of music, exploring its deep, hereditary roots.

title: Death Came Knocking
overview: In the summer of 1978, two cousins are trapped inside their childhood home by a group of strangers. As the night continues, survival slowly turns to murder.

title: The Polar Express
overview: When a doubting young boy takes an extraordinary train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

title: Mustang
overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.

title: Traqueteo
overview: I look around and observe the landscape. I let myself go because that's all I have left: to listen, to look, to sleep, perhaps to dream. The rattle of the bus moves me.

title: The Buffalo Miracle
overview: Follow the unfolding of a catastrophic blizzard that swiftly buried the city of Buffalo in snow and darkness, cutting power, heat, and visibility to residents trapped at home and on roads. A McDonald’s manager breaks protocol to create an impromptu refuge, people instantly mobilize to rescue their neighbors, and a community comes together in the most unexpected Christmas Eve celebration.

title: MORELIFE
overview: A young man's plan to jump into an icy river at night is interrupted by a half-man half-fish there for the same reason. These two strike a bargain to find a rare Morel mushroom hoping it will provide something worth living for.

title: Mi casa no es tu casa
original_title: Mi casa no es tu casa

title: Super Scam Me
overview: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

title: Going Home Project: Ravel & Shostakovich in Cinema
Alchemy in Venice
overview: In the eclectic world of Venice Beach, three artists searching for purpose find their lives unexpectedly intertwined.

title: Stuck
overview: A visit to her brother Daan takes a dark turn when Emma discovers that he has become rooted in a field on his farm.

title: My Home
overview: Gyu-bin, a college student without a home, is struggling to meet her basic needs. One day, she's offered a place to stay by Geum-rim, an elderly woman living in a luxurious house. Geum-rim warmly welcomes her and treats her like a granddaughter. But soon, Gyu-bin senses something is off. She suffers from nightmares and feels a strange presence in the house. She has no choice but to stay, but can she survive what's coming?

title: Tristes Tropiques
overview: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.

title: Layover Hotel
overview: A flight from Incheon to London's Kingsford Smith Airport is canceled due to an engine malfunction, and passengers are provided with a complimentary overnight stay at a layover hotel. Six strangers, unexpectedly stranded together, each have a unique and unforeseen experience throughout the night. This temporary stay becomes a moment of reflection on their lives.

title: The Broken Voice
overview: Letters, diaries and secrets left by its protagonists, historical and prior unknown materials revisit the life and death of Federico García Lorca, one of Spain’s most beloved and internationally recognized poets.

title: Marigold Battle Heart 2026 ~ Day 10: Mask Fiesta 2026
original_title: Marigold Battle Heart 2026 ~ Day 10: Mask Fiesta 2026
overview: Battle Heart 2026 ~ Day 10: Mask Fiesta 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold, held on November 14, 2026 at 176BOX in Osaka, Japan.

title: The Dweller on the Threshold
overview: Following the disappearance of her father, a young woman seeks closure through looking into the last case he was working on.

title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

title: Goody Goody
overview: During a prolonged home birth trapped by a raging blizzard, expecting parents and their midwife begin to suspect something sinister is lurking nearby as labor complications escalate and their sense of safety unravels.

title: The Animals
overview: After another man is hailed as a hero, an insecure boyfriend becomes determined to prove that he, too, can protect the woman he loves.

title: Black Water
overview: 19-year-old Noah, who's living with his mom and sister in an old, dilapidated house on the outskirts of Boston, is sitting in therapy, as he's suffering from dark and potentially dangerous visions at night. During one of his sessions, he's asked to revisit some of these visions, forcing him back to a time of horror and distress.

title: Blood Before Bitcoin
overview: Myrna, a former gang member, runs a roadside motel with her younger boyfriend, Floyd. When her old gang arrives for a mysterious Bitcoin heist, buried grudges, jealousy, and betrayal threaten the score- and the new life Myrna fought to build.

title: The Best Man
overview: A bachelor party mystery centered around figuring out who of the attendees is the best man of the coming wedding.

title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
original_title: प्रहार: दी अनटोल्ड स्टोरी ऑफ़ उज्ज्वल निकम
overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

title: From Inside Out: The Architecture of Peter Zumthor
original_title: From Inside Out - Die Architektur von Peter Zumthor
overview: We all come from houses in which we live, dream, love and die. This long-term documentary project explores the significance of architecture in our everyday lives and takes its audience on a journey to the most impressive places designed by Swiss architect Peter Zumthor.

title: De Tatta's: Daan
overview: Daan wants to impress his crush, Layla. He promises to come up with the most epic gift ever for her birthday party. What seems simple turns into a chaotic quest, filled with bizarre situations and unexpected encounters.

title: Camouflage
overview: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

title: PSYCHO
overview: When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes. Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

title: The Seoul Guardians
overview: On December 3, 2024, in Seoul, the President of South Korea Yoon Sukyeol declares the martial law. Troops move toward the National Assembly to seize control. Meanwhile, citizens rush to the National Assembly to block the troops, while lawmakers break through police's barricades at the main gate, climb over the walls to attend the session that lifts the martial law.

title: TOE′S
overview: After injuring his pinky toe while working at a distribution center, Mingi receives a mysterious package. Inside is something unexpected, something he could never have imagined.

title: Fernanda
overview: A portrait of one of Brazil’s greatest actresses, centered on the one thing inseparable from her identity: her craft. The documentary follows Fernanda Montenegro through her most recent work while looking back at the past to trace the making of a great actress over the course of her career. Directed by Pedro Waddington, son of filmmaker Andrucha Waddington—Fernanda’s son-in-law—the film embraces their family relationship as part of its narrative, capturing intimate moments with the actress backstage and unveiling previously unseen footage of projects made together as a family.

title: Yang Datang dan Yang Pergi
overview: Sinta (Dian Sastrowardoyo), the only daughter of Hartini (Retno Soetarto), inherits the family’s old Wiryo Guest House, a place that holds many memories from the past to the present. Amid the comings and goings of guests, Sinta is reunited with Banawan (Roy Sungkono), her childhood friend and the man she once loved. However, the presence of several other male guests brings with it hope, love, and betrayal, which slowly drag Sinta and her family into various problems.

title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

title: Nobody's Violence
overview: Follows a travelling girl offering euthanasia services in a dystopian world.

title: If I Were You 3
overview: Two decades after their last body swap, Cláudio and Helena are living a new phase of their lives alongside their daughter Bia, now an adult and married with Aquiles. Everything seems balanced until an unexpected situation shakes up the family dynamic and puts their relationships to the test. When lightning seems to strike the same place again, the whole family is forced to learn to put themselves in each other's shoes, in a very literal way.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: Boss Cat
overview: When her mother suddenly dies, Sonja is thrown into tumult. Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.

title: Olaya
overview: José Olaya, the national hero who defied the sea for Peru’s independence. A humble fisherman accepts the mission of crossing 23 kilometers of open sea, carrying crucial messages in the fight for freedom.

title: The Wildest Hunt
overview: Young biologist Marta Medved comes to the small town of Veliki Dabar to investigate the murder of a large bear, whose body has been discovered before the mayor's holiday home. Her arrival will suddenly wake up the sleepy highland town and its collection of seemingly normal residents, each with secrets of their own, including Marta's ex-husband Mauro and his agressive brother Mišel. To get to the bottom of the mystery at hand, Marta has to join forces with inspector Bolf, a kind hearted, but clumsy law enforcement officer, but, unbeknownst to both of them, they'll stumble upon a grand conspiracy that, in one way or another, involves the entire town.

title: I Built a Rocket Imagining Your Arrival
original_title: Fiz um Foguete Imaginando Que Você Vinha
overview: Fifty-something Rosa, lying in an MRI scanner, is prompted to summon a happy memory. She plunges into a meandering, subconscious road trip with her indomitable mother, both queer, where wild imagination becomes a tender, unruly form of therapy.

title: Exchange
original_title: เรียน แลก ผี
overview: A mother searching for her missing 18-year-old exchange student daughter in Canada. As she investigates, she discovers an eerie mystery surrounding the host family and is forced to confront forces that may have taken over her child's body.

title: Love, After All
overview: The everyday life of a married couple at a turning point: Lore wants a divorce—after almost 40 years of marriage.

title: The Dark Gets In
overview: When a documentary team set out to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a young girl, events soon take an unexpected turn, leading the filmmakers down an increasingly dark and horrifying path.

title: XY9
overview: Mar and Iván see parenthood as a possible answer to the fractures in their relationship. As repeated miscarriages and genetic problems complicate that hope, the couple must confront what they are asking a child to repair, and whether their shared future can survive the weight of that desire.

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: The Caregiver
overview: Valea leaves for Italy to earn money for an apartment, but Valera loses the family's savings. Desperate to hide the truth, he heads to Italy and gets caught up with Italian mobsters, precious stones, and total chaos.

title: Closure
overview: Three friends must come together to settle their differences when their lack of romantic connection causes one of them to act out.

title: Appofeniacs
overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

title: Nickels
overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

title: Gaman
overview: Bhau and Mai, an elderly couple from rural Konkan, travel to Mumbai to stay briefly with their sons for minor medical treatment. Though their sons-Pratap, Manohar, and Sharad-are well settled and caring, Bhau and Mai struggle to adjust to city life, longing for their village home and fields. Meanwhile, Kundan and Tara, siblings displaced by floods in Uttar Pradesh, arrive in Mumbai seeking work. After much hardship, Kundan finds employment at Pratap's catering business. During Ganeshotsav, Bhau and Mai return to their village, and Kundan and Tara accompany them to assist. In the absence of their city-settled children, the siblings fill an emotional void, forming a deep bond with the couple.  When Kundan and Tara must return to their own village to claim flood compensation, Bhau and Mai are left alone once more. Bhau later passes away, and aging forces Mai to move permanently to Mumbai. The village home and fields fall silent.

title: Stranglehold
overview: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

title: Violette
overview: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

title: Offroad
overview: Set under the southern sun of the Canary Islands, three friends find themselves in over their heads in pursuit of freedom, dreams and a man named Francisco.  Maggie’s (Sofie Jo Kaufmanas) life looks perfect; she has a career, a home and a boyfriend, but inside she is slowly being suffocated by expectations and the weight of her own ambitions.  With her friends Eva (Julie Rudbæk) and Stine (Katinka Lærke Petersen), she sets out on a girls’ trip to Tenerife in search of freedom and dreams. But soon, one impulsive decision sends her and her two best friends on a reckless and chaotic journey across the island in a campervan.

title: Thella Kaagitham
overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

title: Street Fighters
overview: The world’s best martial artists come together for a world championship organised by a mysterious organisation. As alliances are forged and enemies emerge, they soon realise there’s more at stake than the grand prize… their lives!

title: Talented
overview: Tereza is a single mother who juggles teaching dance and caring for her daughter, Pina, with help only from her elderly father. Her life is turned upside down when her daughter joins a children's talent show. Pina wants to reach the finals in Rio de Janeiro, hoping to return to her hometown. As they rehearse, the girl reignites dreams from her mother's past.

title: Breakers
overview: Pink creatures suddenly appear, dancing in Hyeok-jun's mind and breaking his world. Then Hyeok-jun faces a new place.

title: The Trial of Alec Baldwin
overview: A provocative examination Alec Baldwin as he faces charges of manslaughter, with a cross-examination of the American legal system and the court of public opinion.

title: Not a Family
overview: The story follows Na Byeong-soo, a young job-seeker whose life is upended when his 60-year-old stepfather commits adultery. During the ensuing parental divorce, Byeong-soo visits a hidden property owned by his stepfather and encounters Geum Chae-rin, a 29-year-old pregnant tenant. Suspecting her of being the mistress, he demands that she leaves, but she refuses, sparking a series of chaotic and emotional conflicts that redefine their understanding of family.

title: Ink
overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

title: The City of the Living
overview: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

title: The Mummy
overview: Dashing legionnaire Rick O'Connell stumbles upon the hidden ruins of Hamunaptra while in the midst of a battle to claim the area in 1920s Egypt. It has been over three thousand years since former High Priest Imhotep suffered a fate worse than death as a punishment for a forbidden love—along with a curse that guarantees eternal doom upon the world if he is ever awoken.

title: The Little Mammoth
overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

title: Basant Kaur
overview: Basant Kaur dreams of representing India in kabaddi, but her life changes after she is sexually assaulted and later betrayed again. Pregnant and traumatized, she survives on the streets until her former classmate Fateh takes her home and cares for her and her newborn child. As Basant recovers her memories, she decides to fight for justice against those who harmed her.

title: Always Yours, Never Mine
overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

title: Direction les Champs
overview: This summer, the Tour de France is finally coming by the tiny village of Laventour. For our 8-years-old Sophie, there’s no way her big brother Benoît can miss it. Once the village’s cycling champion, he hasn’t spoken, left his room or shown any interest for the outside world for months. But Sophie isn’t giving up that easily : the peloton is coming… and so are they!

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Cam Girl
overview: CAM GIRL is a romance drama about four cam models at four very different points in their careers. It moves between the noise of the adult industry and the quiet, often lonely life on the other side of the camera.  Alana is a grocery store clerk in Medellín who can’t cover her grandfather’s medicine when her best friend Roxana tells her to try camming. Sally is a rising cam star in Cyprus, still grieving her father and losing herself in everything her new life can buy. Hope is a perfectionist who hides what she does from the man she’s falling for, hoping he’s the one thing she’s missing. Lexi is an industry icon pulled in every direction, shut off from the real world and from herself.  Their stories cross, and together they show what life as a cam girl actually looks like.

title: Hazirun
overview: In the early morning following a night shaken by citywide protests, Ali, a man in his twenties, is awakened by police sirens and forced to act as a “Hazirun” during a search of a neighboring apartment. Drawn into the process with no ability to intervene-valued only for his presence, signature, and silence-Ali becomes trapped in a gray zone between law, authority, and conscience, as events spiral out of control and irreversibly fracture his everyday life.

title: Mistletoe Massacre
overview: Marion Callevero has her guest list checked twice to host the company Christmas event, but gifts quickly turn to gore. This struggling staff has been invited to the party but no one will be returning home for the holidays.

title: The Voice Still Carries: The Aimee Mann Story
original_title: La vita e il trionfo di Aimee Mann
overview: Chronicles the life of singer-songwriter Aimee Mann; from her early life to her eventual triumph over the music industry as the tentpole indie artist of her generation, and how she continues to inspire artists to this day.

title: Miller Night Football
overview: Chronicles comedian Dennis Miller's unlikely arrival in the "Monday Night Football" (MNF) broadcast booth in 2000, alongside veteran sportscaster Al Michaels and former NFL quarterback Dan Fouts. Intended to reinvigorate the iconic television franchise and attract a broader audience, Miller's addition, and his distinctly cerebral brand of humor, was met with both intrigue and skepticism across sports and television.

title: Hager (Land)
overview: ​In 1973, the Jewish community of the village of Gonderchomriam in Ethiopia is preparing for a dangerous journey on foot through Sudan to the Land of Israel. Yitzhak (58), an independent farmer and owner of a successful homestead, refuses to leave his hard-earned land and crops, to disconnect from the soil where he grew up, and to set off on a journey into the unknown. His stance leads to a fierce conflict with his wife Sarah (45), who is determined to hit the road with their three children. However, the family's entanglement in a blood feud forces Yitzhak to send Sarah and the children on the journey to Sudan en route to Israel, and to recalculate his life's path.

title: Ghost Light
overview: Actress Marion Neal finds herself mired in a lawsuit over the rights to her playhouse. As strange occurrences begin to take place, the hidden truth emerges regarding an intricate web of interwoven conspiracies and villainous agendas.

title: Doll of Deceit
overview: A woman's affair with a hired handyman takes a dark turn when her husband discovers the betrayal, leading to a suspenseful tale of captivity and an eerie transformation that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Who will survive?

title: UFC 335: Oliveira vs. Lopes
overview: UFC 335: Oliveira vs. Lopes is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that is scheduled to take place on December 12, 2026, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: Boss Cat
overview: When her mother suddenly dies, Sonja is thrown into tumult. Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.

title: Olaya
overview: José Olaya, the national hero who defied the sea for Peru’s independence. A humble fisherman accepts the mission of crossing 23 kilometers of open sea, carrying crucial messages in the fight for freedom.

title: The Wildest Hunt
overview: Young biologist Marta Medved comes to the small town of Veliki Dabar to investigate the murder of a large bear, whose body has been discovered before the mayor's holiday home. Her arrival will suddenly wake up the sleepy highland town and its collection of seemingly normal residents, each with secrets of their own, including Marta's ex-husband Mauro and his agressive brother Mišel. To get to the bottom of the mystery at hand, Marta has to join forces with inspector Bolf, a kind hearted, but clumsy law enforcement officer, but, unbeknownst to both of them, they'll stumble upon a grand conspiracy that, in one way or another, involves the entire town.

title: I Built a Rocket Imagining Your Arrival
original_title: Fiz um Foguete Imaginando Que Você Vinha
overview: Fifty-something Rosa, lying in an MRI scanner, is prompted to summon a happy memory. She plunges into a meandering, subconscious road trip with her indomitable mother, both queer, where wild imagination becomes a tender, unruly form of therapy.

title: Pacific Rim
overview: Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, Earth's survivors take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes who now stand as Earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

title: Exchange
original_title: เรียน แลก ผี
overview: A mother searching for her missing 18-year-old exchange student daughter in Canada. As she investigates, she discovers an eerie mystery surrounding the host family and is forced to confront forces that may have taken over her child's body.

title: Love, After All
overview: The everyday life of a married couple at a turning point: Lore wants a divorce—after almost 40 years of marriage.

title: Will You Still Be My Friend
overview: Amid an escalating feud in a rural Taiwanese village, a boy struggles to protect his secret friendship with his Singapore-raised best friend as adult conflicts threaten to tear them apart, while he quietly begins to question the true nature of his feelings for his friend.

title: It Will Happen Tonight
overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

title: Kaohsiung Breakout
overview: Adapted from the infamous Kaohsiung Prison riot in Taiwan, this story follows six inmates who plot a daring jailbreak to protest the injustices of the judicial system.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
original_title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
overview: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

title: Mad Max
overview: In the ravaged near-future, a savage motorcycle gang rules the road. Terrorizing innocent civilians while tearing up the streets, the ruthless gang laughs in the face of a police force hell-bent on stopping them.

title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert Let It Snow
original_title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert Let It Snow
overview: Andre Rieu's annual concert celebrating the magic of Christmas.

title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
original_title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
overview: It’s Halloween, and Ducobu is back for an adventure filled with laughter and mystery! Professor Latouche and Miss Rateau move into a house haunted by the ghost of Anatole, the biggest dunce in the history of Saint-Potache School. This mischievous ghost will drag Ducobu, Léonie, their parents, and Kitrish into a series of hilarious and unexpected adventures. But beware: on Halloween, anything can happen!
