title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
original_title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
overview: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.

title: Butterfly Jam
overview: 16 years old Pyteh splits his time between the wrestling mat and his family’s struggling Circassian diner in Newark. A single impulsive decision by his hustling father changes the course of his life, shaping a tale of pride, legacy, and masculinity.

title: 아기상어 크리스마스 스페셜: 산타 선발 대회
original_title: 아기상어 크리스마스 스페셜: 산타 선발 대회

title: Land of Shadows
overview: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

title: Unang Pasok
overview: Catch two of the freshest faces, Kim Yashii and Mayumi De Vera, as they ignite the screen with their undeniable chemistry while dishing out sizzling first time experiences from VMX movies. First time never felt this good!

title: Rushes of a Killer
overview: Footage found in Amsterdam reveals the horrific events that took place behind the scenes of a sinister film project. The recordings show the disturbing creative process of an obsessive filmmaker in pursuit of absolute control.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Boltzmann's Brain
overview: According to statistical physics, within the vastness of chaos, a consciousness could spontaneously emerge from nothingness, carrying memories of a world that may never have existed.  Boltzmann awakens in a white room, where time seems suspended and reality begins to unravel. As his surroundings slowly transform, he struggles to understand who he is, while the boundaries between existence and disappearance gradually dissolve.

title: Orange-Flavoured Wedding
overview: The Puig family has seven children. And today is the wedding of the youngest: Jacques. It's March 1978 in a church in a suburb of Nantes. The father isn't attending the wedding; he's been banished from the family. Jacques is marrying Martine, a young woman who lives in the same neighborhood. It's a love match. But can love heal the wounds of childhood?

title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
original_title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

title: A Knight to Remember
overview: A statue of an English knight arrives in Chicago for an art exhibit. While cleaning the statue, museum conservator Emily impulsively kisses the statue, bringing him to life.

title: The Dark Gets In
overview: When a documentary team set out to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a young girl, events soon take an unexpected turn, leading the filmmakers down an increasingly dark and horrifying path.

title: XY9
overview: Mar and Iván see parenthood as a possible answer to the fractures in their relationship. As repeated miscarriages and genetic problems complicate that hope, the couple must confront what they are asking a child to repair, and whether their shared future can survive the weight of that desire.

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: The Caregiver
overview: Valea leaves for Italy to earn money for an apartment, but Valera loses the family's savings. Desperate to hide the truth, he heads to Italy and gets caught up with Italian mobsters, precious stones, and total chaos.

title: Closure
overview: Three friends must come together to settle their differences when their lack of romantic connection causes one of them to act out.

title: Appofeniacs
overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

title: Nickels
overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

title: Gaman
overview: Bhau and Mai, an elderly couple from rural Konkan, travel to Mumbai to stay briefly with their sons for minor medical treatment. Though their sons-Pratap, Manohar, and Sharad-are well settled and caring, Bhau and Mai struggle to adjust to city life, longing for their village home and fields. Meanwhile, Kundan and Tara, siblings displaced by floods in Uttar Pradesh, arrive in Mumbai seeking work. After much hardship, Kundan finds employment at Pratap's catering business. During Ganeshotsav, Bhau and Mai return to their village, and Kundan and Tara accompany them to assist. In the absence of their city-settled children, the siblings fill an emotional void, forming a deep bond with the couple.  When Kundan and Tara must return to their own village to claim flood compensation, Bhau and Mai are left alone once more. Bhau later passes away, and aging forces Mai to move permanently to Mumbai. The village home and fields fall silent.

title: Stranglehold
overview: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

title: The Martian
overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

title: Violette
overview: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

title: Dolphins: My Close Encounters
overview: Swiss marine biologist Angela Ziltener has been diving with wild dolphins in the Red Sea for over 15 years. What began as a scientific study evolved into a deeply personal journey. As she found herself becoming increasingly immersed in the world of dolphins, Angela was confronted with a more profound question: Who was actually observing whom here?

title: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story
original_title: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story
overview: At the height of his career, Dane Cook wasn't just selling out arenas; he was redefining what a stand-up comedian could be. Then, in a shocking betrayal, the person he trusted most stole millions of dollars, forever changing his life. FUNNY MONEY: THE DANECOOK STORY is a gripping documentary about fame, family, greed, and survival, revealing the extraordinary true story behind one of comedy's biggest icons.

title: Heil Jupiter!
overview: Amidst crashing waves and monumental rocks on a distant coast, two young couples open up a realm of shifting realities. Unbeknownst to them, a mysterious entity watches from high above with Godlike judgment. Between these spaces exists a world balanced on the edge of the modern and the primitive, the high-tech and the rural, the corporeal and the mythic.

title: Pumpkin Regatta Romance
overview: When their fathers refuse to move past a disagreement, Nadine, daughter of the boat shop owner, and Ethan, a pumpkin farmer, team up to heal the feud and revive the town's Pumpkin Regatta.

title: Viva Carmen
overview: 1845, Seville, a pulsating town of sailors and small-time crooks. Teenage Salvador, assistant to the gifted knife grinder Antonio, encounters a captivating young gypsy woman, Carmen. Her stunning beauty and independent spirit set the town abuzz, but Antonio's mystical ability to glimpse the future in sharpened blades foretells a tragic fate for Carmen at the hands of a soldier, José. With unwavering resolve, Salvador musters an eclectic band of misfit street kids, led by the spirited Belén, to challenge the unyielding threads of destiny and protect Carmen from inevitable doom.

title: Deep in the Heart II: Texas Rivers
original_title: Deep in the Heart II: Texas Rivers
overview: Water, wildlife, and land conservation in Texas. Wildlife stories from each of Texas' major river basins, as well as diving into our state's successes and failures when it comes to managing water for both people as well as ecosystems.

title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
original_title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
overview: A violent crime committed against a much-loved local and the police investigation brings bad news for DS Marlene Pettigrew. Love is also in the air and there’s a wedding to plan, but this is Port Devine, what could possibly go wrong?

title: Kraken
overview: In a housing project, an abandoned tower fuels rumors. As strange disappearances multiply, five young people have no choice but to enter once again. Trapped in a deadly snare, they will soon realize that escaping will be impossible…

title: Till Lindemann - Live in Kraków
overview: Filmed at TAURON Arena in Kraków, Poland, on December 1, 2025, this concert film captures Till Lindemann’s 'Meine Welt'-Tour. Lindemann and his band perform a set spanning his solo work and songs from the Lindemann project, including “Sport frei,” “Praise Abort,” and “Ich hasse Kinder.”

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: The Grand Master
overview: Based on the game of Chess that delves into the conflicts and confrontations of people between the rich and poor class and high and low strata of society. How does an ordinary boy, from the community of sanitation workers, become a grandmaster?

title: Beauty from Surrender
overview: Laurelyn tries to build her music career in Nashville after a painful breakup, while Jack tries to find his way back to her.

title: Romanovs: Loyalty and Betrayal
overview: The film tells the story of the final years of the life of Nicholas II, the last emperor of Russia. It follows his devoted wife, Empress Alexandra; his son, Tsarevich Alexei; his daughters, Grand Duchesses Olga, Tatiana, Maria, and Anastasia; and his brother, Grand Duke Michael Alexandrovich. The love and loyalty of those closest to Nicholas accompanied him through the most difficult years of his life. But they could not protect him from betrayal. The treachery and cowardice of members of the Romanov dynasty, politicians of every kind, and generals who had sworn allegiance to the throne ultimately led to the collapse of the empire. The story of the imperial family unfolds against the backdrop of a tragic turning point in history.

title: Hippo Love
overview: Two strangers meet at a Greek-Finnish wedding while going through their own breakups. Touko, a musician who has had little success and is still married, feels attracted to Eevis, who is in the process of getting divorced. Touko's wife, the famous singer Leena, is also a guest at the wedding and notices the attraction between Touko and Eevis. Amidst the stunning Greek seascapes, the conversations that take place over the course of one evening touch on parenthood, childlessness, sex, divorce, marriage, and, of course, love, while the guests celebrate a memorable wedding.

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

title: The Hunt
overview: A teacher lives a lonely life, all the while struggling over his son’s custody. His life slowly gets better as he finds love and receives good news from his son, but his new luck is about to be brutally shattered by an innocent little lie.

title: 9 Temples to Heaven
original_title: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
overview: A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.

title: 58th
overview: Fifteen years after the Maguindanao Massacre, the family of its 58th victim fights for the justice that remains elusive.

title: The Birthday Party
overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

title: The Tale of Fairy Tales
overview: Modern-day Ivan dislikes fairy tales and doesn't believe in them. One day, he accidentally falls into a magic chest and finds himself in a world of fairy tales. To return home, Ivan must confront evil spirits, make friends, and accomplish a truly heroic feat.

title: Think Good
overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: The Chosen: Season 6 Premiere
overview: The sixth season premiere of the popular Biblical television series, following Jesus' arrest and trial leading up to His crucifixion.

title: Heart of Stone
overview: Following the death of his parents, an estranged son seeks forgiveness for a mortal sin–only to draw the short end of the stick.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: Until the Day Ends
overview: Two teenagers protesting political repression must flee, taking with them only their love and a dog.

title: Accueil du grand âge, la méthode Montessori
original_title: Accueil du grand âge, la méthode Montessori
overview: As Western populations grow older and cognitive disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease become increasingly prevalent, how can we rethink the way we care for and accommodate the elderly? More broadly, how should we approach our relationship with aging and old age?  The Montessori method, originally developed and recognized for fostering children’s development in educational settings, has proven particularly well suited to older adults. More than simply a practical tool, it represents a genuine shift in perspective on aging, one that is also revolutionizing approaches to care.

title: Japan : Toyoko Kids
overview: Roaming the streets of Tokyo at night are the so-called "Toyoko Kids", marginalized youths rejected by Japanese society. They have found refuge in Kabukichō, the country's most notorious district. Officially, authorities count 300 Toyoko Kids; in reality, there are likely thousands of them, invisible or ignored.

title: Little Tragedies
overview: In 2011, Daniel Nolasco moved from his small hometown in the Brazilian countryside to Rio de Janeiro. He went to college. He was the first of a group of queer friends to leave the city. Ten years later, none of the people who made up that group live there anymore; some have died, and those who are alive have moved away. The city is called Catalão, a place that everyone says is too good to live in.

title: Reservoir Dogs
overview: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime begets violence as the survivors -- veteran Mr. White, newcomer Mr. Orange, psychopathic parolee Mr. Blonde, bickering weasel Mr. Pink and Nice Guy Eddie -- unravel.

title: Who Does the Chores?​
overview: Soram visits her aging grandmother, who prepares dinner while struggling to breathe. Years later, after leaving home and taking on housework for the first time, she begins to understand the weight of "domestic labor." Reflecting on the invisible work carried by her mother and grandmother for decades, she questions how housework is divided, valued, and gendered. Through conversations with friends and care workers, she discovers the reality of domestic labor: essential to sustaining life, yet still unequally distributed.

title: The Legend of Captain Scarlet
overview: Inspired by the Super Space Theatre compilations of the 1980s. An exclusive new feature-length New Captain Scarlet movie experience.

title: Gluten is a Joke
overview: Gluten is a Joke is a powerful documentary exploring how gluten-free living became a punchline in pop culture and the real harm behind the humor. For many, what is dismissed as a trend is a serious medical necessity.  ​Through personal stories and community voices, the film highlights those living with celiac disease and other medically required gluten-free lifestyles, revealing how jokes, skepticism, and stigma can lead to isolation, misunderstanding, and health risks.  Rather than rejecting humor, Gluten is a Joke asks a deeper question: How can we laugh without causing harm?  It calls for empathy, awareness and respect for lived experiences.

title: Closing Night
overview: A celebrated actress's life begins to unravel on the eve of her greatest performance. When her sister April arrives in New York after a 30-year estrangement, the stage is set for a tense family confrontation.

title: Paris Cafe
overview: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

title: ENHYPEN VR CONCERT : DESTINY
overview: On the night a crimson moon rises, ENHYPEN come face to face with the one destiny they have long awaited: ENGENE. Breaking the rules of the vampire world, they choose love and run away, only to face the same cruel fate again and again. Even with danger closing in as sharp as a “Knife,” the words they say to comfort each other, “Big Girls Don't Cry,” lead them into a forbidden love called “CRIMINAL LOVE.” What ending awaits this love, sealed in blood?

title: Traces of Home
overview: Delving into the past and not shying away from the dug-up pain, a young filmmaker speaks to her Mexican mother and Palestinian father about their trying journeys into the United States. In a society with rhetoric increasingly vilifying Mexicans and Palestinians, the filmmaker picks up her camera in a bid to address the grief at the center of the generational trauma that has underscored her relationship with her family. A meditation of loss and grief relieved, ultimately, through reconciliation.

title: Home Alone
overview: Eight-year-old Kevin McCallister makes the most of the situation after his family unwittingly leaves him behind when they go on Christmas vacation. When thieves try to break into his home, he puts up a fight like no other.

title: You+Me - Against the World
overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

title: Era Uma Vez Minha 1ª Vez
overview: The first time rarely goes the way we expect—especially when we expect too much. Teresa, Clara, Tuca, and Patty are in a hurry and make a pact: lose their virginity before high school prom night. They just forgot one tiny detail: everyone moves at their own pace.

title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
original_title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
overview: Journey through the 1970s and early ’80s with the original members of Jimmy Buffett's Coral Reefer Band as they recount their contributions to iconic albums, life on tour, and the lasting impact they had in shaping a unique and enduring genre of music.

title: Roma elastica
overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

title: Motherf*ckers
overview: When Martín learns that his mother is going to marry Juan, the bully who tormented him as a child, he does what any son would do: sabotage the wedding... by sleeping with Juan's mother.

title: Before We Leave Tuscany
overview: A weary mother seeking solace retreats to a serene Tuscan villa, where the adorable Italian innkeeper and a handsome novelist with writer's block, draw her into a story of unexpected connection and renewal.

title: BASTA: Start of the Game
overview: Rostov in the early 2000s was the cradle of Russian hip-hop: clubs, apartment concerts, street brawls. Basta searched for his voice, facing trials, mistrust, and hostile competitors, but it was his honest lyrics and charisma that first captivated the Rostov hip-hop community. Against the backdrop of first love, friendship, and family trials, he made his ultimate choice: to devote himself to music.

title: Sukiyaki
original_title: SUKIYAKI 上を向いて歩こう
overview: In 1963, as Japan emerged from the shadows of war into an era of extraordinary transformation, an unlikely song made music history. "Ue o Muite Arukou," known internationally as "Sukiyaki," became the first Japanese song to top the U.S. Billboard charts, remaining at No. 1 for three weeks and captivating listeners around the world.

title: 9 Temples to Heaven
original_title: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
overview: A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.

title: 58th
overview: Fifteen years after the Maguindanao Massacre, the family of its 58th victim fights for the justice that remains elusive.

title: The Birthday Party
overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

title: The Tale of Fairy Tales
overview: Modern-day Ivan dislikes fairy tales and doesn't believe in them. One day, he accidentally falls into a magic chest and finds himself in a world of fairy tales. To return home, Ivan must confront evil spirits, make friends, and accomplish a truly heroic feat.

title: Think Good
overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: The Chosen: Season 6 Premiere
overview: The sixth season premiere of the popular Biblical television series, following Jesus' arrest and trial leading up to His crucifixion.

title: Heart of Stone
overview: Following the death of his parents, an estranged son seeks forgiveness for a mortal sin–only to draw the short end of the stick.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: Venom
overview: Investigative journalist Eddie Brock attempts a comeback following a scandal, but accidentally becomes the host of Venom, a violent, super powerful alien symbiote. Soon, he must rely on his newfound powers to protect the world from a shadowy organization looking for a symbiote of their own.

title: They Make Themselves Small
overview: On the trail of a serial killer rumored to be an ancient demon God, Detective Moss must confront her own demons before the darkness consumes her and everyone she loves.

title: Four Seasons in Java
overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. But coming home also means confronting the four men who sent her to prison and now rule the village. Together with the outcasts, Pertiwi begins to uncover the darkness that still haunts the place - and the past she thought she had left behind.

title: Becoming Zendaya
overview: From Oakland dance classes to Emmy wins and box-office records, Zendaya's journey to Hollywood icon status through strategic choices, boundary-setting, and creative ambition—from Disney Channel star to producer and power player.

title: The End of Rainbow Valley
overview: In the lands of Rainbow Valley, the unicorn has been murdered by TTEC, an evil corporation ruled by the boss Beecycle Catan. Etienne Bourlingue, a modern-day sheriff, has sworn to protect the unicorn’s horn—no matter the cost...

title: Through the Wall
overview: In November 1947, Wieslawa Pajdak was arrested for her activities in the anti-communist underground and sent to prison on Rakowiecka Street. A few days later, Jerzy Smiechowski was placed in the next cell. One night, they begin talking through the wall via Morse code. Although it's hard to believe, this is how they met and fell in love. They got engaged through a wall. Seven years later, they married in prison, where they met for the first time. They lived together for fifty years.

title: All We Have
overview: Follows Salem and Dalya,  who fall in love during a dawn raid in a landscape defined by surveillance and military brutality.  As their relationship unfolds across marriage, separation, and the hope of parenthood that magically dares to reclaim stolen time, prison becomes the film’s deepest wound. Its violence does not end at the cell door, but continues inside Salem, reshaping his mind, his tenderness, and his place within the life they are trying to build. A story told through the poetic verses of our Hakawatieh (female storyteller), All We Have is an intimate portrait of love under siege and occupation, and of the psychic cost of captivity.

title: A Free Woman
overview: Fifty-year-old Roma is going through the most difficult time in her life. The only thing she dreams of is a new home. When she once again comes up against bureaucracy and loses sight of improving her situation, all she can do is to forget herself for a moment.

overview: The film looks back at Rexach’s more than 45-year association with FC Barcelona, from his time as a youth player and first-team footballer to his work as a coach, sporting director, scout and presidential adviser. It focuses on his role in some of the club’s defining periods, particularly his relationship with Johan Cruyff, the success of the Dream Team, and his involvement in the discovery and signing of Lionel Messi.

title: Save the Date for Christmas
overview: Susie has checked out on dating while Alec is a hopeless romantic, and these longtime friends have both struck out in the love department after failing to meet the right man. After being each other's plus-one to what feels like the twentieth wedding this year, they vow to take a break from attending weddings and looking for their respective prince charming. That break doesn't last long. The next day, Susie's sister announces a last-minute Christmas wedding... and Susie convinces Alec to tag along. The objective for the week? Survive as the two lone single people and avoid family matchmaking. Over time, the Christmas wedding duties and time with family during the holidays force these two best friends to forge a new appreciation for love and marriage. Susie finds herself turning over a new leaf in pursuing romance while Alec discovers love can walk into your life when you least expect it.

title: Snatch
overview: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookies, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers, and supposedly Jewish jewellers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

title: Gone with the Wind
overview: The spoiled daughter of a Georgia plantation owner conducts a tumultuous romance with a cynical profiteer during the American Civil War and Reconstruction Era.

title: Dasher
overview: A down-and-out food delivery driver, Josh, and a fiery restaurant worker, Kayla, team up for a comedic and chaotic night of deliveries. Demanding customers, stolen sushi, and the festive mayhem on Christmas Eve push some life back into their lives and get them to dream just a bit more. Set in urban Honolulu, DASHER is a local take on what’s likely a nationwide story for young people living the gig economy – where working long hours just to get by discourages any life beyond the next gig.

overview: A Shanghai woman journeys alone to a rubber plantation in southwest China, where her late father was sent during the Cultural Revolution. As she searches for a mysterious woman, some strangers unexpectedly drift into her path.

original_title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

title: It's a Medical Miracle
overview: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

title: The Road Not Taken
overview: A celebrated TV host, facing a crumbling marriage and a strained family, discovers she—not her father—has a hereditary disease, forcing her to reclaim her identity before memory fades.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Adam, a religious teacher who stopped performing ruqyah after losing his wife, is asked to save Fitri, who is being terrorized by supernatural forces. When he resumes performing ruqyah, he uncovers a dark secret behind Fitri's terror.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: F*ck de Familie
overview: When brother Ben suddenly dies, Bo (Yolanthe Cabau) gets with her husband Saïd the care assigned for Ben's teenage daughter Emma. She wants to do this as well as possible, but clashes already quickly with the rest of the family. Everyone - Bo's parents first - thinks to know what is best for Emma. While her demanding job drives her further and further into a corner, Bo's marriage wavers and all good intentions degenerate into a battle full of old pain, new secrets and family dramas that no therapy helps against.

title: Al Baraneya
overview: Pregnant Amal lives together with her family in Al Baraneya, a village outside Cairo, surrounded by jasmine fields. Their chaotic yet loving way of life is upset when a landowner offers to buy their land. The pressure to sell divides the family and doubts begin to grow. When Amal’s cousin Rania visits from Cairo, she captivates Amal and her younger sisters with her modern lifestyle: jeans, TikTok videos, and lively city stories. Amal starts to question the life that seems to have been laid out for her and dreams of moving to Cairo. Now that the potential sale of the land offers the prospect of a future in the city, the family’s unshakable faith in their own life in the village starts to waver.

title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

This marks the beginning of a frantic race involving legal manoeuvres, temptations and dramatic twists.

title: Apophis 2029
overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
original_title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
overview: The Bayeux Tapestry is one of the treasures of the medieval world. Across 70 metres of exquisitely embroidered scenes, it tells the story of one of the most seismic events in British history – the Norman Invasion of 1066.  For the last 950 years, this crucial part of Britain's national story has remained on the other side of the English Channel, in Bayeux, Normandy, but now it’s coming back to the UK.  A stellar cast of historians and experts follow the painstaking efforts to bring this priceless work of art back to the UK, where experts believe it was made, for a once-in-a-millennium exhibition at the British Museum.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Red Wave​
overview: In 1948, a red wave rose. From Yeosu to Busan, the filmmaker traces lives and memories layered along the sea. The Yeosu-Suncheon Incident erupted when soldiers stationed in Yeosu refused orders to suppress the Jeju 4·3 uprising, and many civilians were killed during the Rhee Syngman government's crackdown. After the Korean War began, the government branded National Guidance Alliance members as communists and carried out massacres nationwide. Beyond the killing sites in both cities lies the sea, along which state violence flowed from Yeosu to Busan.

title: Last Man in Tower
overview: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

title: Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie, Part 2
original_title: 最終楽章 響け！ユーフォニアム 後編
overview: Kitauji High School's brass band finally reaches nationals. However, the soloist rivalry between Kumiko and Mayu fractures the entire ensemble, forcing Kumiko to make a pivotal choice both as band president and a musician.

title: Land of Wonders
overview: Young artist Philip unexpectedly finds himself in a true Land of Wonders—a secret, magical world hidden in the vast expanses of Siberia. A thrilling adventure awaits him, meeting the fantastical Imor people and their amazing animals. But due to human intervention, the Land of Wonders and its inhabitants are in danger of destruction. Philip must save this magical world and his new friends at any cost.

title: Mandaadi
overview: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: Don't Save The Date
overview: Meshi, a barista from Tel Aviv who likes to mess around, has a great habit of avoiding responsibility. He promises his best friend to organize the most luxurious bachelor party ever - and then completely forgets about it. When the day of the party arrives and the obsessive bride hands off the groom to him with very detailed operating instructions, Meshi realizes the severity of the problem he set himself into. With no other choice, he starts planning the event on the go. Soon enough, things get out of control. Between nonstop moments of insanity and some moments of simple truth, Meshi discovers that he might not have been "on it" as he believed.

title: Haje
overview: Hoping to settle in Gunsan, filmmaker Hwang Yun encounters the ruined village of Haje in 2018. Nearly every resident has left, but Jeon Jin-hyeon remains, resisting eviction by the Ministry of National Defense. A 600-year-old hackberry tree, another of Haje's last inhabitants, is threatened by expansion of a U.S. military base. Peace activists gather to protect it, and Yun joins them. As dangerous weapons arrive at the base, they hold the monthly Paeng Paeng Cultural Festival, seeing Haje and the tree as a frontline of peace. After more than five years of effort, the tree is designated a national heritage site.

title: Guria
overview: In Guria, western Georgia – where progress has yet to take hold following the collapse of the USSR – the locals struggle to survive day to day in the 1990s, with humor, songs, and unwavering solidarity.

title: Ground Floor
overview: On the eve of departure for the summer holiday with his wife Vera, Kristóf unexpectedly discovers black mold on the wall behind their closet. Overwhelmed with the situation and convinced it is caused by a water leak somewhere in the building, he begins knocking on his neighbours' doors in search of its origin. What seems like a simple maintenance issue soon spirals into a tragicomic housing revolution, forcing Kristóf to confront not only a crumbling apartment block but also the deeper cracks running through contemporary Hungarian society.

title: Santo António - Lisbon Love
original_title: Santo António - O Casamenteiro de Lisboa
overview: Lisbon's traditional Saint Anthony's Weddings have hit rock bottom. At least, that's what Stardust, a major French multinational poised to take over the event, believes. Carmo and Valentim, two Lisbon City Hall employees who have spent more than 25 years organizing the celebrations, are given a harsh ultimatum: reinvent the event and turn it into a modern success, or lose their jobs. Directed by the filmmaker behind The Gilded Cage, Saint Anthony is a vibrant comedy and a heartfelt love letter to Lisbon. A celebration of human connection, identity, and cultural resilience in an increasingly globalized world.

title: Union Town
overview: Set against the backdrop of New York City, the film follows delivery industry workers as they take on some of the world s most powerful corporate giants, touching on the challenges, joys and human elements that make this movement possible.

title: Objet a
overview: Ingeborg and Adam are visionary hand surgeons bound by love, control, and irresistible fixations. She is compelled to steal objects; he longs to become one. When an accident brings the enigmatic Gaia into their lives, unexpected desires begin to take shape, unsettling the careful balance that has long defined their relationship.

title: Love, My Way
overview: Qian was bent on experiencing love and fully committed to every relationship, but all the men she met were unreliable. Qian's best girlfriend, Tingting, also suffered in love, but as time goes by, Qian and Tingting gradually went on to different life trajectories…

title: Love & War
overview: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.

title: Rinrada the Influencer
overview: When a female influencer is destroyed by social media backlash to the point of taking her own life, she gets a second chance as a spirit with only 28 days before she is forgotten forever.

title: Mate's Rate
overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: The Woman When
overview: Media personality Dina El Kordi runs a women’s empowerment center and launches a large social media campaign aimed at supporting women and addressing stubbornness or lack of understanding in married life. The campaign sparks widespread controversy in society between supporters and opponents.

title: Where Is Your Faith
overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

title: The Last Island
overview: Hoang and his son An, long at odds, are stranded on a deserted island—forcing them to survive together and rebuild their bond from the ground up.

title: The Saddest Story in the World
original_title: A História Mais Triste do Mundo
overview: Based on the book by Mário Corso. The story of a boy sold to the circus by his own parents.

title: Speed and Battle
overview: A pair of estranged father and son are forced to team up amid a city destruction crisis triggered by drone technology, fighting against a frantic conspiracy at life-threatening speed. This is not only a race to stop disaster, but also a chance to fix their broken relationship.

title: Cradle of Coaches
overview: This documentary delves into the history of remarkable leaders, their groundbreaking achievements, and the profound connections that have shaped football’s greatest coaching legacy.

title: Disney Worldbuilders
overview: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

title: Closure
overview: Starting from the first cinematic experience of seeing Rambo 3 on TV as a three year old in besieged Sarajevo and the memory of a fallen family member- this film morphs into an exploration of the relationship between reality and cinema images.

title: Borges and Me
overview: Jay Parini finds himself stuck in a Morris Minor, chauffeuring the brilliant, blind Jorge Luis Borges through Scotland. Quiet and conservative, 23-year-old student Parini dreams of becoming a writer but is at a loss to make sense of the wild, irrepressible 70-year-old Borges. As the journey takes a surreal turn, their differences magnify until, in the tradition of a classic road trip, the two ultimately find common ground.

title: Hushar Pittalu
overview: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

title: Sometimes Sadness, Sometimes Rebellion
original_title: A veces me entra tristeza, otras veces rebelión
overview: Eva is just passing through Madrid. She spends her days there alone: she doesn't know anyone and isn’t particularly interested in getting to know new people. The city is therefore an unfamiliar place where she wanders aimlessly, her curiosity somewhat dampened. But one afternoon, at the Reina Sofía Museum, a man approaches her. His name is Dante and he is an Argentine historian researching labor struggles in his country and the career of Juan Bialet Massé.

title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors
original_title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors
overview: After his domineering mother dies, reclusive farmer Ed Gein descends into madness, hearing her voice urging him to punish sinful women and turning his home into a house of horrors.

title: Boatbuilders
overview: Over the course of 16 months, at the head of a remote harbor in Maine, the workers of the Brooklin Boat Yard meticulously build a 56-foot wooden sailboat. As the seasons change and the vessel takes shape, director Luke Lorentzen immerses the viewer in a close-knit community rooted in time-honored craft, shared joys, and mutual respect.

title: Shaun of the Dead
overview: Shaun lives a supremely uneventful life, which revolves around his girlfriend, his mother, and, above all, his local pub. This gentle routine is threatened when the dead return to life and make strenuous attempts to snack on ordinary Londoners.

title: Conversation with the Sea
overview: In Jerusalem, Kamal, a 60-year-old Palestinian man, is ordered by an Israeli court to pay a large social security debt allegedly owed by his son Wael. But Wael drowned in the Red Sea decades ago. When no official record of his death can be found, Kamal follows the only remaining lead to uncover what happened to his son.

title: An Impossible Word of Praise
overview: One day, Gustav hears a rumor that he will be replaced by another butler; the anxiety and uncertainty grow so strong within him that one night he decides to escape.

title: Godzilla
overview: Japan is thrown into a panic after several ships are sunk near Odo Island. An expedition to the island led by Dr. Kyohei Yamane soon discover something far more devastating than imagined in the form of a 50 meter tall monster whom the natives call Gojira. Now the monster begins a rampage that threatens to destroy not only Japan, but the rest of the world as well.

title: A Clockwork Orange
overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?

title: The Pervert's Guide to Utopias
overview: Philosopher Slavoj Žižek is our guide through landscapes of classic film, music, social media, archive and webcasts. Making unexpected twists and turns, he maps the utopian illusions of our times. Through absurd juxtapositions and startling insights, we are seduced into recognising our fate, in order to change it.

title: The Green Mile
overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.

title: F1 on Apple TV Live in IMAX: Italy Race
original_title: F1 on Apple TV Live in IMAX: Italy Race
overview: IMAX hits “The Temple of Speed” aka the Autodromo Nazionale Monza on September 6. This high-speed Italian track has the designation of being the fastest in Formula 1®, making it exactly the kind of setting IMAX was made for. Hug every turn and feel the rumble in your seat when you take your experience into IMAXimum overdrive.

title: Rocky IV
overview: Rocky Balboa holds the world heavyweight championship, but a new challenger has stepped forward: Drago, a six-foot-four, 261-pound fighter who has the backing of the Soviet Union. This time, Rocky's training regimen takes him to Siberia, where he prepares for a globally televised match in the heart of Moscow. But nothing can truly prepare him for what he's about to face – a fight to the finish, in which he must defend not only himself, but also the honor of his country!

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
original_title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
overview: When Gethsemane is invited to play at a wedding, she and Eamon find themselves involved in the death of a member of the bridal party.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
overview: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
overview: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.

title: Sky Defenders
overview: As missiles and drones reshape modern warfare, the battle for control of the sky has never been more critical. Sky Defenders goes inside the world of NASAMS, one of the world’s most advanced air-defence systems. From its origins in Norway to military operations across Europe, Australia and Ukraine, the film reveals the technology, international partnerships and people behind a system built to protect the skies. With extraordinary access to soldiers, engineers, factories and live military exercises, Sky Defenders is ultimately a story about the people behind the technology and the race to protect millions from an evolving threat from above.

title: Octopus Skin
overview: Iris and Ariel are 17-year-old twins, who live with their mother and older sister in an old house in the middle of a rocky island covered with molluscs and birds. The teenagers have grown up isolated from the mainland, in a sibling relationship that surpasses the limits of normal intimacy. The abrupt absence of their mother deeply wounds the three siblings, and Iris, moved by a strong need of separating herself from her brother, decides to go alone to the city for the first time.

title: Eternals
overview: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
original_title: cocoon～ある夏の少女たちより～
overview: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

title: Kaiji: Life Revenge Game
original_title: カイジ 人生リベンジゲーム
overview: Burdened by debt, Kaiji Itou is forced into a series of high-stakes gambling games where he must risk everything to survive and take control of his future.

title: Down the Arm of God
overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

title: The Burglars
overview: An elderly woman, Eunja, who lives in the countryside, teams up with Palbok, a burglar, to embark on a spree of robbing empty houses.

title: The Batman
overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

title: Confessions of a Shaman
original_title: คำสารภาพของหมอผี
overview: A man who decides to inherit the art of shamanism to exact personal revenge, leading to a series of terrifying events that change his life forever.

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.

title: City of God
overview: In the poverty-stricken favelas of Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, two young men choose different paths. Rocket is a budding photographer who documents the increasing drug-related violence of his neighborhood, while José “Zé” Pequeno is an ambitious drug dealer diving into a dangerous life of crime.

title: Elegy for the Forgotten, on an Endless War
original_title: Elegy for the Forgotten, on an Endless War
overview: Fourty years after the Iran–Iraq War bombs fall once again on Iran, weeks after street protests ended in the massacre of thousands of Iranians. While Israeli and American bombs fall, the regime keeps images under tight control. An endless war... of images.

title: Orion
overview: A holiday with an end in sight and a birthday to start it all. A further illustration of divide within London, United Kingdom during 2026.

title: Scarface
overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

title: Brave New Love
overview: Hypnotherapist Kate lives with her husband, Orla, and their daughter, Athena, while simultaneously maintaining a deeply romantic - and highly secret - relationship with Andreas. As a role model to her daughter, she struggles to navigate her existential quest - a journey filled with body fluids, intimacy, Greek mythology, laughter, madness, and clumsiness. We follow Kate through darkness and sunshine in this erotic, existential modern love story, as she battles society’s norms and dares to redefine the rules of love.

title: The Mummy: Reckoning
overview: In the closing days of the Second World War, the SS attempt to manufacture immortality using stolen Egyptian funerary rites. What they create is not eternal life, but a mummified revenant, a sadistic officer bound into undeath by occult ritual. Buried, forgotten, and sealed beneath a British coastal fort, the relic waits. When it is uncovered decades later, the war resumes, only this time it is personal.

title: You Shouldn't Know This
overview: A detective’s search for a missing man leads him into a conspiracy hidden deep within his own department. As the investigation begins to unravel, the line between justice and obsession starts to disappear.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: The Hunt Down 2
overview: In 2004, on the vast Gobi wasteland of northwest China, the violent gang led by Xu Sihai robs a mine escort vehicle, committing a series of bloody crimes before fleeing for their lives. During the escape, the gang falls apart, turning against each other over stolen loot. Criminal police captain Yang Zhigang traverses the desert to hunt them down based on trace clues, leading to a slew of hardcore gunfights and car chases. Moral gray areas complicate this showdown between good and evil.

title: THE RIBBON HERO
original_title: THE RIBBON HERO リボンヒーロー
overview: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

title: Men in Black
overview: After a police chase with an otherworldly being, a New York City cop is recruited as an agent in a top-secret organization established to monitor and police alien activity on Earth: the Men in Black. Agent K and new recruit Agent J find themselves in the middle of a deadly plot by an intergalactic terrorist who has arrived on Earth to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies.

title: Addiction
overview: After finally building the life he once dreamed of, a young man begins to feel suffocated by the constant effort it takes to maintain it. Exhausted and disillusioned, he starts to lose sight of why he worked so hard in the first place.. As his addiction tightens its grip, his reality begins to fracture. Without the substance, his mind spirals-distorting his perception and isolating him from the world around him. Soon, he starts seeing a dark, shadowy version of himself lurking in the distance... watching, waiting, and slowly getting closer. What begins as an escape turns into a psychological nightmare, as the figure grows impossible to ignore-an eerie manifestation of his unraveling mind, and a haunting reflection of the path he's chosen.

title: Wicked
overview: In the land of Oz, ostracized and misunderstood green-skinned Elphaba is forced to share a room with the popular aristocrat Glinda at Shiz University, and the two's unlikely friendship is tested as they begin to fulfill their respective destinies as Glinda the Good and the Wicked Witch of the West.

title: The Weird Kidz
overview: Three 12-year-old boys, including the precocious Dug, excitedly tag along with Dug’s older brother and his new girlfriend for a night of fireside camping. Their good times are rudely interrupted, though, when a local monster legend known as the “Night Child” turns out to be all too real.

title: Alterity
overview: A group of paranormal researchers discover a dormant alien invasion force hidden in an abandoned shopping mall slated for demolition.

title: First Fire
overview: Clara gives birth to her first child. In the chaos of postpartum, she tries to get her life back on track.

title: The Lighthouse
overview: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

title: Ponyo
overview: When Sosuke, a young boy who lives on a clifftop overlooking the sea, rescues a stranded goldfish named Ponyo, he discovers more than he bargained for. Ponyo is a curious, energetic young creature who yearns to be human, but even as she causes chaos around the house, her father, a powerful sorcerer, schemes to return Ponyo to the sea.

title: Hill 338
overview: New comedy film inspired by the Israeli classic "Halfon Hill Doesn't Answer", released to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. Ran Shem Tov, a "disassembly officer" who was deployed to command due to "military streamlining needs", is recruited for this mission. But the thing Ran and the heads of the IDF don't know is that an old bunker was built beneath the base, for which no one remembers the cause of construction. Lately, strange things have been happening in it, which delay the base's shutdown. These events bring all soldiers together against internal and external forces.

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: The Comeback King
overview: A country western star named Aubrey must return to college to earn his long-abandoned degree after a false rumor that he cheated on his girlfriend throws his career into free fall.

title: Un homme libre
overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.

title: Sorry, Charlie
overview: A remote helpline volunteer is targeted by "The Gentleman," a stranger who lures women from their homes with a recording of a crying baby.

title: Niu Lai
overview: The naive calf Niu Lai loves exploring the grasslands, but struggles to live up to his family’s expectations as future leader of the herd. With migration fast approaching, Niu Lai finds unlikely allies on his journey to learn the meaning of courage as they prepare for a dangerous trek across the desert.

title: Free Guy
overview: A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.

title: God of This Age
overview: Several friends gather for a night of fun and relaxation; unfortunately, it might be their last. What appeared to be a simple game turned into something darker. One wrong job, one random text, one group of friends, opens the world to a new type of danger. Is it just technology running rogue or something more sinister?

title: Rush
overview: A 17-year-old is given a final ultimatum to hand in an assignment by 9:00am or fail his class. After staying up all night to finish it, he wakes up late and begins a frantic race to school, facing a series of increasingly chaotic obstacles along the way.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.

title: Black Swan
overview: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake."

title: World War Z
overview: Life for former United Nations investigator Gerry Lane and his family seems content. Suddenly, the world is plagued by a mysterious infection turning whole human populations into rampaging mindless zombies. After barely escaping the chaos, Lane is persuaded to go on a mission to investigate this disease. What follows is a perilous trek around the world where Lane must brave horrific dangers and long odds to find answers before human civilization falls.

title: Letter from a Tree to Humans
Ameer Log
overview: Three carefree friends from a bustling Hyderabad basti spend their days wandering narrow lanes, sharing plates of biryani, and dreaming of a better life. When an old cook's secret recipe brings unexpected success their way, they must choose between fleeting fame and the enduring value of friendship, memories, and the taste of home.

title: & Sons
overview: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

title: Billy Knight
overview: After losing his father, Alex discovers a box of unfinished scripts and a handkerchief with the name “Billy Knight” embroidered on it. Consumed with the desire to discover his identity, Alex embarks on a Hollywood adventure to track down this mysterious and reclusive Billy Knight.

title: Apoy Sa Ibabaw, Apoy Sa Ilalim
original_title: Apoy Sa Ibabaw, Apoy Sa Ilalim
overview: A rice cake vendor who saves the life of a man who has amnesia. As the two get closer and fall in love the man’s fiancée finds him.

title: The Snare
overview: When a high school student is arrested with a small amount of drugs, the police pressure her to become an informant—forcing her to choose between the people she most loves and the future she's worked so hard to create.

overview: Cisco and Cheska, a long-term couple, embark on a final "break-up trip" to decide whether to let go or fight for their relationship after years of growing apart due to conflicting ambitions.

title: How to Save the Immortal 2: Elixir of Life
overview: Drybone the Immortal and shieldmaiden Barbara are preparing for their wedding, but not all of Barbara's relatives are happy about the union. Her strong-willed aunt, Queen Brungilda, believes her niece deserves a more suitable match. In a misguided attempt to stop the wedding, she unwittingly casts a powerful sleeping charm on Barbara. The Queen proclaims that the legendary Elixir of Life can save Barbara, but only a true noble knight will survive the treacherous path to the Elixir, hidden in a perilous place where danger lurks at every turn. Drybone, known as a dark sorcerer, stands no chance in this noble quest, so he enlists Elijah, a true and valiant knight but clumsy and fearful , to join him. In a tale filled with action, magic, and humor, only a true  hero can save Barbara and restore peace and joy to the kingdom.  Elixir of Life is an epic animated family adventure that celebrates love, bravery, and the quest for genuine heroism.

title: First Blood
overview: When former Green Beret John Rambo is harassed by local law enforcement and arrested for vagrancy, he is forced to flee into the mountains and wage an escalating one-man war against his pursuers.

title: Mr. Shota's Last Business Trip
overview: Shota, a machinist who dedicated his life to his work, prepares for his final business trip to Korea before retiring. Meanwhile, Daesung heads to Japan to win back his ex-girlfriend. The two men happen to meet at a ramen shop on the first day of their journeys. When Shota's resignation letter and Daesung's love letter are swapped, an unexpected story begins.

title: My Husband, My Wound
overview: A devoted mother trapped in an abusive marriage finds hope through a courageous women's rights lawyer as her daughter's worsening condition forces her to fight for freedom and her child's survival.

title: The Knowing
overview: After a mysterious event leaves a young woman deeply shaken, she finds herself caught in a series of increasingly disturbing encounters that force her to confront fear, fate, and her own survival.

title: The Summer in Between
overview: A shy scholarship girl enters an elite summer camp and falls into a dangerous love triangle with rich siblings Kris and Kat, awakening feelings she never expected.

title: Love the Dead
overview: One year after a zombie apocalypse, a mother and daughter are forced to choose between survival and family.

title: What Remains at Dawn
overview: In Singapore, executions take place at dawn. Years after her brother’s death sentencing for drug trafficking, a sister duo continues their early-morning journeys, carrying the quiet aftermath of a punishment the city no longer sees.

title: The Boy and the Heron
original_title: 君たちはどう生きるか
overview: While the Second World War rages, the teenage Mahito, haunted by his mother's tragic death, is relocated from Tokyo to the serene rural home of his new stepmother Natsuko, a woman who bears a striking resemblance to the boy's mother.  As he tries to adjust, this strange new world grows even stranger following the appearance of a persistent gray heron, who perplexes and bedevils Mahito, dubbing him the "long-awaited one."

title: Devil Box
overview: Kev, a dim-witted office worker, tries to win his father’s favour and save the world after his new mom, Bela, lets him in on a conspiracy involving his younger brother, Kody, and his plans to take over their family business.

title: Little Women
overview: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

title: Shrek 2
overview: Happily ever after never seemed so far far away when a trip to meet the in-laws turns into a hilariously twisted adventure for Shrek and Fiona. With the help of ever-faithful Donkey, Shrek takes on the potion-brewing Fairy Godmother, pompous Prince Charming, and infamous ogre-killer Puss In Boots.

title: Love Actually
overview: Eight very different couples deal with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London.

title: AEW Double or Nothing 2026
overview: The 2026 Double or Nothing was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on May 24, 2026, at Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York City, New York, USA. It featured the first quarter-final matches of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournaments for both the men and women, as well as the long-anticipated AEW International Championship match between Don Callis Family members Kazuchika Okada (c) and Konosuke Takeshita. The show was headlined by Darby Allin (c) vs. MJF in a Title vs. Hair match for the AEW World Championship, where MJF would have to shave his head bald if he lost.

title: Ali G Indahouse
overview: Ali G unwittingly becomes a pawn in the evil Chancellor's plot to overthrow the Prime Minister of Great Britain. However, instead of bringing the Prime Minister down, Ali is embraced by the nation as the voice of youth and 'realness', making the Prime Minister and his government more popular than ever.

title: Man Across The Street
overview: A chilling psychological thriller where a woman fleeing an abusive past moves across the street from a master manipulator. Blending domestic suspense with a "house of horrors" twist.

title: Models vs. Werewolves
overview: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon...

title: For the Opponents
overview: In the tough neighborhood of Tepito, a boy faces the great Mexican dream: becoming a boxing champion.

title: The Last Spring
overview: Marion and Camille, 15, are inseparable. They arrive on a southern island for their final school trip, full of excitement and expectation. It’s a time of firsts, and the abrupt end of carefree days.

title: The Dream Is a Snail
overview: A struggling young artist takes an odd job as a human racetrack in a senior rejuvenation workshop, only to develop an obsession with the hypnotic sensation of snails gliding across his skin.

title: Disney+ Insider: The Mandalorian and Grogu - A New Mission Launches at Disneyland Resort
original_title: Disney+ Insider: The Mandalorian and Grogu - A New Mission Launches at Disneyland Resort
overview: Go behind the scenes at Star Wars: Galaxy’s Edge at Disneyland Resort as Disney+ Insider explores the evolving story of Batuu. Hosts Anthony Carboni and Katarina Cruz experience the land and its newest offerings, encountering iconic characters like Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, Han Solo, and Darth Vader. Along the way, they meet the Mandalorian and Grogu, sample themed treats, and hear from director Jon Favreau about bringing these beloved characters to the big screen. From immersive character moments to updated adventures like Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and new nighttime projections, fans can experience Batuu in exciting new ways. See “The Mandalorian and Grogu” in theaters and IMAX.

title: The Last Tupper
overview: Gabriel, a 65-year-old man marked by the loss of his wife Alicia, faces the challenge of rebuilding his life after the arrival of Yuqi, a new tenant, and reconnecting with his daughter Lidia, with whom he has a distant relationship.

title: Saccharine
overview: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

title: Monay
overview: Mona, a desperate woman fighting to save the bakery she shares with her younger sister, Monina. When a wealthy businessman offers financial help in exchange for a risky arrangement, Mona must risk love, family, and herself.

title: Oflu Hodja 6: Treasure
overview: Oflu Hodja 6: Treasure tells the story of Oflu Hodja and his team, who turn the Black Sea upside down in pursuit of the treasure they are after.

title: Burrow
overview: A year after the death of her brother, a young woman joins her friends on a drug-infused getaway that spirals into a night of horror when an alien insect burrows into one of her friends, transforming him into a vicious man-eating creature.

title: Man in Hanbok
overview: Jang Yeong-sil, a genius scientist, rises from slavery to the rank of jong sam pum (Senior Third Rank) thanks to King Sejong's favor, but after the palanquin incident of 1442, he disappears completely from historical records. Where did he go? In 20th-century London, a painting by Rubens titled "Man in Hanbok" appears in an auction at Christie's. The identity of this unknown Asian figure painted by Rubens traces back to the era of King Sejong in the 15th century. Though born a slave, Jang Yeong-sil possessed exceptional brilliance. However, he receives an order from Ming China demanding that he be executed or handed over to them. With King Sejong's help, he escapes by joining the Ming explorer Admiral Zheng He on a voyage to Europe and even meets the Pope in Italy. But Jang's belief that the world is round is deemed heretical, and the Pope orders his execution. Fleeing for his life, Jang reaches Florence alone, where he encounters a seven-year-old Leonardo da Vinci.

title: Love Kills
overview: In downtown São Paulo, absolutely ravaged by crack cocaine, Helena, a young black vampire, wanders around a filthy café trying to captivate Marcos, a naive waiter. As she begins to discover his secrets and the ins and outs of the metropolis, the girl will go on to venture into a dangerous world of immortal intrigues that will challenge her own mortality.

title: Bearcave
overview: Set in the Greek mountain village of Tirna, Bearcave follows Argyro, a badass farmer, and her best friend Anneta, the village "it" girl and local manicurist. Once Anneta admits that she's pregnant and planning to leave town with her lame cop boyfriend, Argyro challenges Anneta to embark on an adventure to find the mystical bear cave. Before Argyro has a chance to confess her own love, Anneta leaves for her new life in the big city. Argyro is left broken. Meanwhile, in her new home with her clingy mother-in-law, Anneta quickly realizes her destiny lies elsewhere.

title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Hama
overview: Trapped in a financially strained household where she is treated more like a servant than a wife, a young woman forces her conflicted husband to choose between his overbearing family and their marriage.

title: Spaceballs: The New One
overview: Forty years after the events of the first Spaceballs, the galaxy is once again under threat. A threat so evil, so unstoppable, so completely lacking in any original ideas, that it has vowed to bring back the past... every last bit of it. With Lone Starr in hiding, Queen Vespa on the throne, and the Schwartz stretched thinner than a franchise releasing TV episodes theatrically, the only hope for the galaxy is Vespa's undisciplined son, Prince Starburst, and a mysterious Palace advisor named Destiny. Together, they must find Lone Starr, Yogurt, and any other iconic legacy characters fans are demanding before they discover the hard way that, while some threats you can fight, the reboot is not one of them.

title: Independence Day
overview: Strange phenomena surface around the globe. The skies ignite. Terror races through the world's major cities. As these extraordinary events unfold, it becomes increasingly clear that a force of incredible magnitude has arrived. Its mission: total annihilation over the Fourth of July weekend. The last hope to stop the destruction is an unlikely group of people united by fate and unimaginable circumstances.

title: A very cheesy love story
overview: Chloe’s just moved from Wisconsin to California. How will she juggle adjusting to her new life and dealing with the stuck up Cali kids when there’s a cute guy in her class offering her a cheese curd? Oh, and she has a boyfriend she’s not crazy about.
